m300217.もう、運動をするのは良いことですが、\nあまりはしゃぎ過ぎてはいけませんよ？: Exercise is fine, but don't get too carried away, okay?
m300217.やるじゃない、\n王子のこと、ちょっと見直したわ。: Not bad, I've reconsidered my opinion of the Prince a bit.
m300217.よかった……ぐすん、\n王子、私達を助けにきてくれたんですね！\nけれど、この状: Thank goodness… *sniff* Prince, you came to save us! But what on earth is happening…?
m300217.よし、じゃあ全員で花札だな。\n鬼刃姫、もちろん相手をしてくれるよな？: Alright, then everyone, let's play Hanafuda. Kibahime, you'll be our opponent, right?
m300217.わかりました。王子、時間がありません。\n急ぎ迎撃の準備をお願いします！: Understood. Prince, we don't have time. Hurry and prepare the interception!
m300217.わたしたちの見立て通りだったよね！\nやっぱりお姫さまだし……。\nきらきらして: We were right, weren't we! She's a princess after all… sparkling, just wonderful… Ah, so cute.
m300217.カードを使って取り合いをするゲームなんだな。\nいやぁ、てっきりカードを\n直接: So it's a game where you use cards to take each other's? I always thought it was a straight-up card-snatching battle…
m300217.ステージかどうかはともかく、\nおかげで悪夢を振り払うことが出来ました。\n王子:
Whether it's a stage or not, thanks to you we were able to shake off the nightmare.
Prince, Mehlis, thank you.
m300217.ロヴィニアちゃんは心配性ですねぇ。\n王子さまもいてくれるし、\n王国の皆さんも: You're so worry-prone, Rovinia-chan. With you, the Prince, and everyone in the kingdom, we'll be fine!
m300217.不利な状況となるのは間違いありませんね。\n何か対抗策があればよいのですが……。: It's certainly a disadvantageous situation. I wish we had some countermeasure…
m300217.世界樹の魔物が次々に活発化しているようですが、\nいったい何が起きているのでしょ: The World Tree's monsters seem to be getting active one after another, but what on earth is happening…?
m300217.今は眠っているのか、落ち着いていますね。\nですが目を覚まして、人里を襲撃したら: It seems to be sleeping, calm for the moment. But if it wakes and attacks a village… I can't even imagine that.
m300217.今年は迷宮とか地下とか、\nいーっぱい潜った気がしますねぇ……。\nこっこほーれ: This year we've been diving into dungeons and underground places a ton… Kokko hop-hop♪
m300217.今日はアンナさんの誕生日でしょ？\nだからプレゼントにって、授業で習ったばかりの: It's Anna's birthday today, right? So for a present I brewed a “good-dream potion” we just learned about in class…
m300217.今食堂の方で、東の国の方が、\nあったかーいお鍋を作ってくれたんですよ。\n良か: Over at the mess hall, the folks from the Eastern lands made a warm hot pot. Want to join us?
m300217.仕方ありませんね。王子、\n魔界ボアがこちらに向かってくる様子はありませんが、\: Looks like we have no choice, Prince. The boars aren't heading straight toward us, but they could pop out from elsewhere at any moment.
m300217.件の魔物かもしれませんね……。\n王子、討伐の準備をお願いします！: It could be that monster… Prince, please prepare for the extermination!
m300217.体型の維持とかも大変そうですよね！\n天馬の負担にならないよう、\n私もしっかり: Keeping in shape must be tough! I need to stay fit too, so I don't become a burden on the Pegasus.
m300217.何がふたりきりだ。\n王子の独り占めは許さないぞ、新兵。: What do you mean ‘alone'? I won't let you hog the Prince, rookie.
m300217.分かってんよ、レーレン先生！\nでも実技と来たら、俺達の得意分野だからなぁ！:
I know, Professor Lehren!
But when it comes to the practical, that's our strong suit!
m300217.分かりました。それでは私達は、\n一度拠点へ戻りましょうか。\nジャイアントクロ: Got it. Then let's head back to base. Good work on taking down the Giant Crawler.
m300217.夢の中だし、そうじゃないかしら。\nそれで、残っていた薬を王子に飲んでもらって、: Since it's a dream, that makes sense. I had the leftover potion for the Prince to take, hoping he could turn Anna's nightmare back to normal.
m300217.奴もワームの一種なら、\n地中を進軍してくるかもしれない。重装甲の\n連中で受け: If it's a kind of worm, it could burrow forward. Let the heavy armor take the hit, and launch an all-out attack on it.
m300217.実技試験では皆さんの対応能力を測るために、\n時間経過によってこちらの編成を調整:
In the practical exam, we'll adjust our formations over time to test your response abilities.
See the handouts for details.
m300217.巨大なワーム……ジャイアントクロウラーが\n出現したというのは、この辺りですか？: A massive worm… a Giant Crawler—did it appear around here?
m300217.数匹ならともかく、この数だからな……。\nもう周囲の魔物が聞きつけて、\nこの場: A few would be manageable, but this many... The surrounding monsters have already caught wind and are gathering here.
m300217.新年を楽しく祝えるのも、\n王国の皆のおかげだよ。本当にありがとね。\n……こん: It's thanks to everyone in the kingdom that we can celebrate the New Year so joyfully. Really, thank you. …I never imagined a peaceful day like this, where we can all just have fun together.
m300217.新手の魔物が現れたっていうのは、\nこのあたりかしら……？: They say a new kind of monster showed up—could it be around here…?
m300217.最初は防御を固めた相手、だっけか。\n防御力の高い敵への対処法……。\n王子はど:
First we face a defensively fortified opponent, right?
How to deal with high-defense enemies...
What will the Prince do...!?
m300217.最後は『出撃コスト』が回復しなくなるのよね？\nここまでにどれだけ余力を残す事が:
The final stage is when deployment cost stops recovering, right?
It'll test how much reserve we managed to keep up to this point...
m300217.本当は私も助けに行きたかったんだけど、\n偶然に出来た薬だから、私の分までは無か: I really wanted to go help too, but the potion was a one-off, so there was none left for me. Please, Prince, protect Anna's dream!
m300217.東の国のお料理、\nとっても美味しかったですからね……。: The food from the Eastern Kingdom was just so delicious…
m300217.東の国の都も、だいぶ復興が進みましたね。: The capital of the Eastern lands has really made great progress in its reconstruction.
m300217.王子、どうかなさいましたか？\n――あら、あちらで騒いでいるのは……。\nはぁ、: Prince, is something the matter? — Oh, it's those folks making a ruckus over there… Huh, they're getting a bit out of hand…
m300217.王子、ひとまず皆さんを止めましょう。\nお説教はその後です！: Prince, let's stop everyone for now. The lecture can wait!
m300217.王子、世界樹に起こるとされる災厄の件も含め、\n今後も油断せずに修練を重ねていき: Prince, let's keep training without letting our guard down, especially about the calamities foretold for the World Tree.
m300217.王子、新年早々お疲れ様でした。\n私達も王国へ帰還しましょう。: Prince, thanks for your hard work right at the start of the new year. Let's all return to the kingdom.
m300217.王子自らが手本を見せてくれるんだ。\nしっかり技を見て覚えるんだぞ？:
The Prince himself will demonstrate.
Watch his technique carefully and learn!
m300217.王都に学校が再建されたのも、\n今年のことでしたっけ。\n私も今度、お勉強しに行: The school in the capital was rebuilt this year, right? I'd love to go study there sometime!
m300217.皆さん、王子が困っていますよ……？\nここは公平に、皆さんでお茶会というのが……:
Everyone, the Prince seems troubled…?
Let's be fair and have a tea party together… .
m300217.砂漠の住人に被害が出る前に、\n可能ならここで討伐してしまいたいな。: Before the desert dwellers suffer any damage, I'd like to take it down here if possible.
m300217.確かに……全くこっちを見ようともしませんね。\nぶももーって歩きまわって、すごく: That's true... they don't even glance our way. They just wander around, “bum-bum,” looking like they're having a great time.
m300217.私が仲間になる前には、邪仙達と幾度も戦い、\n鬼たちの抗争に立ち向かい、\n吸血: Before I joined the party, I fought the evil sages countless times, stood against the demons' war, and thwarted the vampires' schemes…
m300217.私は今、眠っているアンナさんに話しかけているの。\n王子にはアンナさんの夢の世界: I'm speaking to the sleeping Anna right now. Prince, I need you to help deal with the emergency unfolding in Anna's dream world.
m300217.私も気になってました！\n猪に鹿に……。\n綺麗な絵が描かれていて、素敵ですよね: I'm curious too! The pigs, the deer… The illustrations are so beautiful, it's wonderful.
m300217.私も行きましょう。\nフーリさん一人では心配ですしね。: I'll come with you. I'm worried leaving Khuri alone.
m300217.緊急事態だっていうから、\n振袖姿のままで急いで駆けつけたんだが……。\n何だか: They said it was an emergency, so I rushed over in my kimono... but they just look like they're strolling around having fun.
m300217.薬で眠って貰って、最初は楽しそうだったんだけど……、\n途中からうなされ出しちゃ: I gave her the potion so she'd sleep, and at first it seemed fun, but then she started having nightmares. I must've messed up the dosage—it turned into a nightmare potion…
m300217.見張り、お疲れ様ですアサルさん。\nジャイアントクロウラーの様子はどうですか？: Thanks for the watch, Asar-san. How's the Giant Crawler doing?
m300217.遊び、ですか？\n鬼刃姫さんがその手に持っている御札って、\n遊びに使うカードな: Play, you say? That talisman you're holding, Kibahime— is it a card you use for games?
m300217.運動ですか……？ でももうちょっと、\n散策したいところもあるんですけど……。: Exercise, huh…? But there are still places I'd like to explore a bit more…
m300217.食べれば食べる程、筋肉になるんだ。\nフィリスも前線を務めるなら、\nしっかり食: The more I eat, the more muscle I build. If you're on the front lines, Phyllis, you need to eat properly too.
m300217.魔物を発見した斥候の方の話では、\nその魔物はこの糸を使って\n獲物を囚えていた: The scout who spotted the monster says it uses these threads to trap its prey.
m300217.魔物達が消えていきます……。\nぐすっ……これで私達のステージは\n守られたんで:
The monsters are fading away…
Sniff… So our stage… has been protected…
m300217.魔王軍が何かを企んでいるのかと思ったが、\nどうやらそういうわけでは無いらしい。: I thought the Demon King's army was up to something, but apparently not. Well then, what shall we do... eat them?
m300217.魔王軍のことや、世界樹にいつか訪れるという災厄と、\n考えなくちゃいけないことも: There's the Demon King's army, the disaster that will someday threaten the World Tree, a lot to think about… but I'm sure next year will be full of good things too!
m300217.魔界ボアの群れが暴れているという話だったが……。\n何やら様子がおかしいな。: We heard the demonic boars were running wild... Something about this just feels off.
m300217.魔界ボアの進路には、\n十分に注意を払っておいてください。\n戦いにくい場所です: Keep a close eye on their paths. It's a tricky battlefield, so we need careful commands.
m300217.（くっ……無意識なのかしら。\n食べ過ぎた私達にとって、\n限りなく痛いところを: (Ugh… maybe it's subconscious. For us who've overeaten, that's hitting a sore spot…)
m300217.（そうね……たくさん食べた以上、\nたくさん運動をしておかなければ……）: (Right… the more we ate, the more we have to exercise…)

m400234.――うぉおおおおっ！！\nさすが王子！ さすが現チャンプだぜ！！\nよぉし、そう:
――Woohoo!!
As expected of the Prince! As expected of the current champ!!
Alright then, if that's settled, let me explain the rules!
m400234.……おや、あんまり乗り気じゃないみたいだね。\nしかし参加しないとなると困るな…:
…Hmm, you don't seem that eager.
But if you don't join, that'll be a problem…
m400234.『多くの敵を撃破すること』が重要で、\nライフが０になってもクリアした事になり、: The key is “defeating as many enemies as possible.” Even if your life hits zero, it counts as a clear, and the number you've slain is recorded as your result.
m400234.『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ奴とか、\nワルキューレを出撃メンバーに\n入れておく: It might be wise to have someone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill, or slot a Valkyrie into your deployment team.
m400234.あたしはあんたの強さをよく知ってるけど、\nそうじゃない奴らがどんな噂をたてるか: I know how strong you are, but you never know what rumors the others will spread.
m400234.いったいどうしたんだい、ドゥーラ。\nそんなに焦らなくても王子はどこへも行かない:
What's the matter, Doula?
Don't worry, the Prince isn't going anywhere.
m400234.えーっとあとは、そうだ！\n魔界武術大会会場には、魔界の瘴気は入ってこない。\n: Uh, let's see… Oh right! The tournament arena isn't contaminated by demonic miasma, so you can fight with your full, true power!
m400234.そ、そっか、現チャンプは王子だからな！\nうぉおおおっ、タイトル防衛戦ッ！\n熱:
I-I see, the current champ is you, Prince!
Woohoo, a title-defense match!
It's so hot! So hot…!!
m400234.そ、それにっ！ せっかく数多の猛者と戦える、\nこんな貴重な機会を逃す手はないよ:
A-and that! This is a rare chance to battle countless fierce opponents—
we can't let it slip away, right? Right?
m400234.それから今回の魔界武術大会では、\n出撃コストが時間経過で回復しないことも\nし: Also, remember that in this tournament, your deployment cost won't recover over time.
m400234.それから敵を倒しても、EXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることは出来ない: And even if you defeat enemies, you won't earn any EXP, gold, or drops.
m400234.だ、だけど……！！\nチャンプ、本当に大事件なんだよ！！\nなんと、魔界武術大会:
B-but…!!
Champ, this is really a huge deal!!
The Demon-World Martial Arts Tournament is finally happening!!
m400234.だから現チャンプらしく、傷つくことを恐れず、\n少しでも多くの挑戦者を倒すことを: So, true to a champion, don't fear getting hurt—just try to take down as many challengers as you can!
m400234.へぇ、また魔界武術大会が開かれるのかい。\n――ということは王子、\n今回はタイ:
Huh, another Demon-World Martial Arts Tournament, huh?
—so that means, Prince,
this time it's a title-defense match.
m400234.やれやれ、楽しみ過ぎてから回っちゃってるね。\nさて王子、もちろん参加するんだろ:
Oh dear, you're getting all worked up.
So, Prince, you'll be joining, right?
m400234.よぉーし、気合入ってきた！\nそれじゃあ王子、魔界武術大会に出発だ！！: Alright, I'm fired up! Then, Prince, off to the Demon Martial Arts Tournament!!
m400234.多数の敵と相対する『大討伐ミッション』は\nもちろん知ってるよな？\n今回も基本:
You know the “Massive Hunt Mission,” where you face hordes of enemies, right?
It works the same way this time.
m400234.王子はチャンプとして、\n向かってくる多数の挑戦者を、\nばったばったとなぎ倒さ: As the champ, you'll have to sweep away the wave of challengers that come at you.
m400234.魔界武術大会は名誉ある武の舞台。\nそれを現チャンプが辞退したとなると、\n王子:
The Demon-World Martial Arts Tournament is an honorable stage for warriors.
If the current champ backs out, it'll tarnish not only your honor, but your comrades' as well.

m400591.…………！\nまだ息があります！\n他の方も急いで捜索しましょう！:
…………!
They're still breathing!
Everyone, let's hurry and search for the others!
m400591.……あっ……思い出しました。\nあの地図と一緒に見つけた書物に、\n滅びた村を守: ...Ah... I remember. The book I found with that map contained records of the knight who guarded this village.
m400591.……さっき私たちが見たのは、\nその時の出来事だったんですね。: ...So what we saw earlier was a replay of that event.
m400591.……それに、気になることがあります。\n亡霊だけならともかく、\nどうして家々ま: ...There's something else that concerns me. If it were just the ghosts, I could understand, but why did the houses remain in their old state?
m400591.……そんな。\n村の人たちが、みんな魔物に……。:
……No.
The villagers have all been turned into monsters…
m400591.……だめ、みたいです。\n言葉が通じていません。:
……It doesn't seem to be working.
He isn't responding to us.
m400591.……どういうことだと思いますか？: ……What do you think is going on?
m400591.……また、ですか。\nこのところ、似た届け出が続いていますね。:
...Again?
We've been getting similar reports like this lately.
m400591.……今は、目の前の敵を退けましょう。\nこのままでは、捜索もままなりません。: ……For now, let's deal with the enemy in front of us. We can't search properly in this state.
m400591.……同じ騎士なら、言葉を交わせるかもしれません。\n意思の残滓があれば、ですが。:
……If he is a knight, we might be able to communicate.
If any of his will remains, that is.
m400591.……王子、村があります。\nでも、地図ではこの辺りには何もないはずでは……。: ……Prince, there's a village ahead. But according to the map, there shouldn't be anything here……
m400591.……誰も暮らしていないのでしょうか。\n王子、慎重に調べた方がよさそうです。: ……Perhaps no one lives here anymore. Prince, we should proceed with caution.
m400591.……追撃はありません。\n王子、ひとまずこの場を離れられそうです。: ……No pursuit. Prince, we can leave this area for now.
m400591.『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ者や、\nワルキューレを出撃メンバーに\n入れるよう気:
Please be sure to include those with the "Request Reinforcements" skill
or Valkyries
in your deployment.
m400591.あっ、あそこに人が！\n――って、大変です！ ゴブリンに囲まれています！:
Ah, there's someone over there!
—Oh no! They're surrounded by goblins!
m400591.あっ、あそこに人が！\nすみません、少しお尋ねしたいことが――: Ah, there's someone over there! Excuse me, I have a few questions—
m400591.あっ、向こうに倒れてる人が。\nもしかして、行方不明になっていた方でしょうか？:
Oh, there's someone collapsed over there.
Could they be one of the missing persons?
m400591.あの、こちらを……。\n捜索願に書かれていた、行方不明者の持ち物が、\n村の中に: Um, look over here. I found the belongings of the missing person listed in the search request lying in the village.
m400591.あの方も、きっと誰かを守りたくて、\n剣を取ったんですよね。: He must have picked up his sword to protect someone, too.
m400591.あの騎士が、どんなふうに人々を守っていたのか。\nそれも、残っているかもしれませ:
It may also contain records of how that knight
protected the people.
m400591.あの騎士が駆けつけたときには、\nもう手遅れだった、ということですか……。:
So, by the time that knight arrived,
it was already too late…
m400591.あの騎士の身体も、透けています。\n先ほど襲われた人たちも、\n皆、亡霊だったの:
That knight's body is translucent, too.
The people who were attacked earlier
were all ghosts as well…
m400591.ええ。捜索は続けます。\nまずはこの村への立ち入りを禁じ、\n調査の準備を整えま: Yes. We'll continue the search. First, we need to forbid entry into this village and prepare for a proper investigation.
m400591.おそらく、あの騎士がこの幻を生み出した元凶ですわ。\n彼を止めればこの事件も終息:
That knight is likely the source of this illusion.
If we stop him, this incident should be resolved…
m400591.おっと……やけに古い地図だな。\nいったいいつの時代のものなんだ？: Oh my…… That's an awfully old map. What era is it from, anyway?
m400591.きっと、彼なりに整理がついたのでしょう。\nもしかしたら、王子が英雄王の末裔だと: I think he finally found some peace. Perhaps, in that brief battle, he realized that you are a descendant of the Hero King.
m400591.さて、今回の作戦ですが、\n『大討伐ミッション』の形式で臨みます。\n目標は、一:
Now, regarding this mission,
we will proceed as a "Grand Sweep Operation."
The objective is to defeat as many enemies as possible.
m400591.それから……全部終わって、\n城へ戻ったら、あの書物を読み直そうと思います。\n:
And then… once everything is over
and we're back at the castle, I intend to read that book again.
Not just about the day the village was lost.
m400591.それで、守れなかった村で、\nあの日を繰り返していたのでしょうか……。: So he was reliving that day, in the village he failed to protect...
m400591.それでは王子、部隊の編成をお願いいたします。\nこれ以上、行方の分からない方が増: Then, Prince, please finalize your deployment. We must head to the site before more people go missing.
m400591.それでみんな逃げ出して、\nやっぱりずーっと無人のままになったです。:
So everyone fled, and
it's been uninhabited ever since.
m400591.では、行方不明になった方々は、\nやはりこの村へ……。: Then the missing individuals must have indeed come to this village……
m400591.でも、行方不明になった皆さんは、まだ……。\nこのまま捜索を終えるわけには……。: But the missing people are still out there... I can't just end the search like this...
m400591.ということは、千年も前の村が、今も……？\n廃村というには、家々がきれいすぎるよ: So, a village from a thousand years ago is still……? It's too well-preserved to be considered abandoned.
m400591.ところで、どうして王国領外なんて言い方をしましたの？\nまるで誰も治めていない地:
By the way, why did you say "outside the kingdom's borders"?
It sounds like no one rules that place at all...
m400591.はい、さらに被害が拡大するおそれがあります。\nまずは王国で現地を調べると、\n:
Yes, there's a risk the damage could escalate.

At this point, even moving properly should be impossible.
m920055.ありがとうございます！ 魔物さん！\n助けようと思ったのに、こちらが助けられまし:
Thank you! Monster!
I came to help, but you ended up saving us.
m920055.あれは僕が教えてあげたんだよ。\nえへへ！\nみんなありがとうね！: I taught them that, you know. Hehe! Thanks, everyone!
m920055.いいえ。貴方を一人にするわけにはいかない。\n永い刻がかかっても、貴方が闇の力か:
No. I won't let you face this alone.
No matter how long it takes, I'll wait for you to be freed from the darkness. You're a dear friend, after all.
m920055.いいぞ……、力がみなぎってくる！\n常闇の聖霊よ、お望み通り、\nこれで人間ども: Good… I feel the power surging! Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness, as you wish, let's eradicate humanity once and for all.
m920055.うるさい！\n私は認めない、認めないぞ！:
Shut up!
I won't accept it, I won't!
m920055.うーむ……。\n武具や技を授けても、それを\n使いこなせねば意味がない。: Hmm… Giving them weapons and techniques is pointless if they can't master them.
m920055.えっと……、神殿になにか御用があったのですか？: Um… did you have business at the temple?
m920055.ぉおう、おめぇら！！\n憎ったらしい人間どものタマぁ、取ってこんかい！！: Hey you all!! I'll snatch those hateful humans' souls and bring ‘em down!!
m920055.お、なんだあの魔物。\n魔物のくせに固そうな鎧を着てやがんなぁ。:
Oh, what's that monster?
Even a monster, but it's wearing some solid armor.
m920055.おお。お前は、魔界に棲むグレーターデーモン\nではないか。丁度いい。お前ならば人: Ah, you must be the Greater Demon that dwells in the demon realm. Perfect. With you, we can bury humanity for good…!
m920055.おお。やっと出来たか。フフ、これはなかなかの\n出来だ。当たったら、少しは……。: Ah, finally done. Heh, not bad at all. If it hits, it'll be… well, actually it'll hurt quite a lot.
m920055.おおおおお。\n変わってゆくのを感じる……！\nかつての力が、若かりしころの力が: Ohhh! I can feel the change…! The power of my youth is returning!
m920055.おお！ そうだ！\n俺よりもその軟弱な奴らどもに力とやらを\nくれてやれ。:
Oh! That's right!
Give that power to those softlings even weaker than me.
m920055.おそらく闇の聖霊は\nまた同じ過ちを繰り返そうとしているはずだ。: She's probably about to repeat the same mistake.
m920055.おやぁ？\n生意気な人間たちめ、まだ生きていたのか。\nもっともっと力をしぼりと: Oh? Those cheeky humans are still alive? I still need to squeeze out even more power.
m920055.おんのれぇ……っ。貴様らぁ！ \nワシをこんな目に遭わせてタダで済むと思うなぁ！: You… You think you can get away with what you did to me for free? Next time I'll definitely kill you!!
m920055.き、貴様は何を言っているんだ。\nくっ……はなせ！ われに触るな！: W-What are you saying? …Ugh… Let go! Don't touch me!
m920055.き、貴様は！\n再び人間たちに力を与えるために\nのこのこ戻ってきたのか！: Y-you! Back again to give humans power, huh?!
m920055.く、くそう……。\nやつらに近づきさえすれば、ワシの強大な\n力をお見舞いしてや:
D-damn it…
If only I could get close to them, I could unleash my tremendous power on them…
m920055.こっちだ。常闇の聖霊を見たのは。: This way. I finally caught sight of the Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness.
m920055.このまま力を悪用されては危険です！\n急ぎ常闇の聖霊の後を追いましょう！: This is too dangerous if they misuse that power! We must chase after the Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness at once!
m920055.これは、大した力を秘めておったようだ。\n力の発現には、もう少し時間がかかるであ: This seems to hold a considerable force. It'll take a little more time for it to fully manifest. I'll be watching with anticipation.
m920055.これ以上はもうやめてくれ！\n私たち聖霊の役目を思い出すんだ！: Stop this right now! Remember our duty as spirits!
m920055.こんな所まで追いかけてくるとは、こざかしい。\nしつこいやつらめ。:
To think you'd chase me this far—how sly.
You persistent fools.
m920055.さぁ、魔物たちよ。われの力を受け取り\n思う存分暴れるがいい……！: Come, monsters. Take my power and run wild to your heart's content…!
m920055.さあ、現世代の英雄がいかほどのものか\n見せてもらいましょう。: Now then, let's see just how great the hero of this generation truly is.
m920055.さて、次はどの魔物に力を与えてやろうか……。: Now then, which monster shall I empower next…?
m920055.しかし、助けてもらったからと\n人間に協力するつもりはない。\n私の勝手にさせて: But just because you helped me, don't expect me to start cooperating with humans. I'll do whatever I want!
m920055.しかし、常闇の聖霊の力はほとんど\n残っていないようだなぁ……。: But it seems the Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness has almost no power left…
m920055.すまない。\nしばらく一人にしてくれ。\n大丈夫、もう馬鹿なことはしないさ。: Sorry. Just leave me alone for a while. Don't worry, I won't do anything foolish anymore.
m920055.そ、そんなバカなぁぁぁぁ……！\nワ……ワシが、人間ごとき……に……！！\nく…:
No… this can't be…!
I… I, a mere human…!!
I… I'm so… angry…!
m920055.そうだ、そこにいる聖霊たちからも力を\n奪えるかもしれないな。: That's right, maybe I can steal power from the spirits over there, too.
m920055.そうだよ。\nみんなが喜んでくれるのが僕の幸せ。:
That's right.
Seeing everyone happy is my happiness.
m920055.そこの金色！\n常闇の聖霊を離しなさい！: Hey, golden one! Release the Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness!
m920055.そしていつしか全ての人間を憎むようになり、\n敵とみなし、滅ぼそうと考えるように: And eventually we came to hate all humans, seeing them as enemies and deciding to destroy them.
m920055.そしてその力を使い魔物たちを強化し、\nやつらを率いて人間界を攻め滅ぼそうとした: She used that power to strengthen the monsters, leading them to attack and annihilate the human world…
m920055.その時は、私たちとも仲良くなってくれると\n嬉しいです。: When that happens, we'd be delighted if she became friends with us, too.
m920055.その通りです。\n憎しみと欲望が結んだ絆などに……。\nそんなものに負けるはずが:
That's right.
We won't be beaten by bonds forged from hatred and desire….
m920055.それなら、フェスさんのために約束してください。: Then, please make that promise for Fes's sake.
m920055.だが、私は友人として闇の聖霊の愚かな行為を止める為に、\n最後の力を振り絞って彼: But as a friend, I must stop her foolish actions, so I gathered my last strength and sealed both of us away.
m920055.だが、闇の聖霊は、人間に力を貸すことで\n自分たち聖霊が犠牲になる事に疑問を抱き: But the dark holy spirit began to doubt sacrificing herself by giving power to humans.
m920055.つ、強い……。まさか、敗北するとは……っ。: I-I'm strong… I never thought I'd be defeated…!
m920055.どこかに強い魔物はおらんものか……ん？: I wonder if there's a strong monster somewhere… hmm?
m920055.な、なんだお前たち！ 人間ではないか。\n人間に力を与えるつもりはないのだが……:
Wh-what are you! Humans?
I have no intention of giving power to humans, but…
m920055.なかなか仲間が集まらんな……。\nおのれ、これでは大妖怪である\nわしのメンツが:
Hardly any allies gathering…
Damn, this is ruining my reputation as a great monster!
m920055.なにかね君は。おや、常闇の聖霊か。: What's that you're after? Ah, it's the Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness.
m920055.なんだと、まさか……私を見逃すというのか。: What… are you saying… you'll let me go?
m920055.はぁはぁ……。\nそ、そろそろワシの力をみせてやるか。\nくっ、それにしても体が:
Haa… haa…
Alright, I'll show you my power.
Damn, my body feels so heavy.
m920055.はぁはぁ……。\nなぜだ……。もうこんなに疲れてしまっている。\n一体どういう事:
Haa… haa…
Why… I'm already this exhausted.
What on earth is happening?
m920055.はい。\nフェスさんも、聖霊の皆さんもどうかお元気で。: Yes. Fes, and all the spirits, please stay well.
m920055.はい。\n魔物に力を与えなければ、あなたを封印する必要は\nなくなりますからね。:
Yes.
If you don't give power to monsters, there'll be no need to seal you.
m920055.ふふっ。力を欲しておるのか？\nならば授けてやろうか？ われの力を……。:
Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness: Heh. You crave power?
Shall I grant it to you? My power…
m920055.ふん。つまらぬなぁ。\n後悔しても知らぬぞ。:
Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness: Hmph. How boring.
I won't care about your regrets.
m920055.ぶははは。\nこのワシから逃げられるわけなかろう。:
Hahaha.
There's no way you can escape from me.
m920055.ま、また負けてしまった。\nツメが甘かった……のか？:
Darn, we lost again.
Were our claws too soft…?
m920055.まあ、いいさ。\nもっと強い魔物でも探しにいくとするか。: Well, that's fine. I suppose I'll go look for even stronger monsters.
m920055.み、みんな逃げろ！\n私の力のほとんどを吸収したこいつには\n誰も勝てない……。: Everyone, run! No one can beat this one that has absorbed most of my power…
m920055.も、もう……、だ、だめだ……。\n息をするのもツライ……。:
I… I can't… I… it's over…
Even breathing is painful…
m920055.もう大丈夫ですよ。\nお怪我はありませんか？:
It's all right now.
Are you hurt?
m920055.もう私たちの力は必要なさそうですね！: Looks like we aren't needed anymore!
m920055.やってみる前にあきらめるのは感心しないね。\nふつうのやり方でダメなら……そう、: I don't admire giving up before trying. If the usual way doesn't work… then, say, devouring the spirits might do the trick.
m920055.やはり、あのデーモンは力を吸収しすぎたようです。\n強大な力を維持するためにはそ:
As expected, that demon has absorbed too much power.
To maintain such overwhelming strength, it needs a matching amount of energy.
m920055.やめろ！\n通常の聖霊は魔物に力を与えることはできない。: Stop! Ordinary spirits can't give power to monsters.
m920055.ようやく倒せましたか……。: Did we finally bring it down…?
m920055.よろしければ詳しい話を\nお聞かせいただけませんか？\nなにかお力になれるかもし:
If you'd like, could you tell us the details?
We might be able to help.
m920055.わしに仲間を結集する力をくれ！\n妖怪軍団を結成し、\n再び人間どもを恐怖に陥れ: Give me the power to gather allies! I'll form a legion of youkai and plunge humanity back into terror!
m920055.われが魔物を使い、人間のいない世界を\n作ってみせよう。\nさすれば、そなたもわ: I shall command monsters and create a world without humans. Then you, too, will finally understand my words.
m920055.ウン。\nイママデ沢山タスケテクレテ、アリガトウ！\nコレカラハ、オレタチダケデ:
Yeah.
Thanks for all the help you've given us so far!
From now on, we'll handle it ourselves.
m920055.エルフ族の争いになど興味はない。\nフフ、まあそうだな。人間を倒そうというならば: I have no interest in the elves' petty squabbles. Heh, well… if you're set on defeating humans, I might just grant you some power.
m920055.グレーターデーモンとは誰のことかな？\n……ワシはもはやグレーターデーモンではな: Who do you think the Greater Demon is? …I am no longer the Greater Demon.
m920055.グレーターデーモンを超えた究極の存在！！\nゴールデンデーモン様だ！！: The ultimate being that surpasses the Greater Demon!! I am the Golden Demon!
m920055.コ、ココハ女神神殿の森！\nタ、タイキャク……。:
Th-this is the goddess's temple forest!
I… I'm terrified…
m920055.ゴールデンデーモンが動き始めました。\nしかし、移動速度が極めて……極めて足が遅:
The Golden Demon has started moving.
But its speed is… unbelievably slow!
m920055.チカラガ、ミナギッテクル……！\nオレタチモ、タタカウ！\nイマナラオークモコワ:
Our power is growing…!
We'll fight too!
We're not scared of the Orc any more!
m920055.チッ。お前らの様な弱そうなやつらに興味はない。\n俺はもっと強いやつと……。:
Tch. I'm not interested in weaklings like you.
I want someone stronger…
m920055.ハハハ！\nこれはちょうどよいところに魔物の群れが。\nさあ、貴様たち！ 一糸乱: Ha ha ha! A perfect swarm of monsters appears right on cue. Now, you! Show me a flawless formation!
m920055.ヒョォォォ！\n見よ！ この鋭きカギ爪を！\n王子！ 今こそお前の首をもらいうけ:
Hyooo!
Behold these keen claws!
Prince! Now I shall take your head!
m920055.フェスさん……。あなたのご友人なんですもの。\n私たちは常闇の聖霊さんがきっとい: Fes… You're a friend of hers. We believe the Holy Spirit will someday return to her true self.
m920055.フェスさん、一緒に後を追いましょう！: Fes, let's chase after her together!
m920055.フェスさん、気を落とさないでください。\n今は一刻も早く常闇の聖霊を見つけましょ: Fes, don't lose heart. We must find the Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness as quickly as possible.
m920055.フェスよ、その必要はない。\nすべては、われ自身が招いたこと。\n封印されるのは:
Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness: Fes, that's unnecessary.
Everything here is my own doing.
If I must be sealed, let it be just me.
m920055.フェス！ \n……そなた、なぜ人間などという\n下等なやつらと共におるのだ！: Fes! …You, why are you consorting with those lowly humans?
m920055.フハハッ。人間同士の戦いは、なかなかに\n面白いものだな。よかろう。\n鬼刃衆と:
Fuhaha. Watching humans fight each other is rather entertaining.
Very well.
Oni Blade Squad, I shall grant you power.
m920055.フフ、ちょうどいい。\nあそこにいる魔物の動きを強化してやろう。: Heh, just the right time. I'll boost the creature over there.
m920055.フン。良いだろう。\n人間ども、悪いがそういうことだ。\n死んでもらおう！: Hmph. Fine then. Humans are a nuisance, after all. Let them die!
m920055.ワシは決めた。\n君を手元にずっと置いておく事にしたよ。\n君は永遠にワシに力を: I've decided. I'll keep you right by my side forever. You'll keep pouring your power into me eternally!!
m920055.世迷い事を言うな！\n人間は聖霊を幸せになどしない！\n私は、私は……。:
Don't spout nonsense!
Humans will never make a holy spirit happy!
I… I…
m920055.人間と聖霊が力を合わせた時、\nどんな困難ものり越えることができる。\nそれを証: When humans and spirits combine their power, they can overcome any hardship. Prove it!
m920055.人間は自分の事しか考えていない\n自分勝手な生き物だ。われらの事なぞ、\n使い捨: Humans only think of themselves—self-centered creatures. They must see us as nothing more than disposable tools.
m920055.何だったのだ今のは……。\nあの動きに何の意味が。\n最後に出てきた騎馬は一体！: What was that just now…? What does that movement mean? And that cavalry that showed up at the end—what on earth!
m920055.先ほどの戦いは見事だった。\n私は光彩の聖霊フェス。改めてお礼を言う。\n助けて:
The battle earlier was splendid.
I am the holy spirit of light, Fes. I want to thank you again.
Thank you for saving me.
m920055.先ほどの魔物だが、おそらく私の友人である\n闇の聖霊のせいだ……。彼女がやつらに: The monsters we just faced were probably because of my friend, the dark holy spirit… She must have given them new power.
m920055.力が……溢れてくる……！\n聖霊のみなさん！\nありがとうございます！: The power… is overflowing! Holy Spirits, thank you!
m920055.力を与えるだと？ 欲しければ自らで奪い取る！\n貴様などに恵んでもらうつもりはな:
Grant power, you say? If I want it, I'll take it myself!
I won't beg you for a gift.
Even without that, I'm strong…
m920055.君はワシの話を聞いていたのかね。\nこの常闇の聖霊はすでにワシのものなのだ。\n: Were you listening to me? This Holy Spirit is already mine. There's no way I'd let it go.
m920055.報告！ 魔物たちが隊列を組んで\nこちらに向かってきています！: Report! The monsters are forming ranks and marching toward us!
m920055.大丈夫、私たちの祝福を貴方達に授けましょう。: Don't worry, we'll grant you our blessings.
m920055.女神アイギス様に、\n力を貸してもらいたいことがあってな。:
???: We need the goddess Aegis' help.
We want to ask for her power.
m920055.妖怪総大将……なかなかのものであったが\n完全に力を取り戻すには\n時間が足りな: The Grand General of the Youkai… impressive, but you didn't have enough time to fully regain your power.
m920055.少し寝ている間に……、\n人間も随分と強くなったものだ。: While I was dozing off… humans have become surprisingly strong.
m920055.常闇の聖霊……。\nやはり、その力を悪い魔物たちに与えていたか。: The Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness… So, it really has been handing its power to those vile monsters.
m920055.常闇の聖霊……。魔物にこんな邪悪な力を\n与えるなんて……。本来ならば友人の私が: Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness… to give such wicked power to monsters… I, as a friend, should be the one to stop her.
m920055.常闇の聖霊……！ ヒョッヒョッ！\n丁度いいところに来てくれた。: Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness…! Heh heh! You came at just the right time.
m920055.常闇の聖霊さん……。\nこれからは、力を悪い事に使わないと……。\n魔物に手を貸:
Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness: From now on, you won't use that power for evil…
Will you promise not to aid the monsters?
m920055.常闇の聖霊さん！ ご無事ですか！？: Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness: You're safe! Are you alright?!
m920055.幸せがある限り、僕は力を取り戻せる。\n何度でもね。:
As long as there's happiness, I can regain my power.
Again and again.
m920055.役目だと？ 愚かなる人間にわれらの力を\n奪われることの何が役目だ。そなたこそ、: A “duty,” you say? What use is it for foolish humans to steal our power? Wake up, you—how long will you keep clinging to your human fantasies?
m920055.彼女がそこまで追い詰められていることに\n私や他の聖霊の仲間たちが気づいた時には: When we and the other holy spirits finally realized how far she had been driven, it was already too late…
m920055.彼女の絶望と呼応するように、\n闇の聖霊は魔物の秘められた力を引きだす能力を\n: In response to her despair, the dark holy spirit acquired the ability to draw out the hidden power of monsters.
m920055.彼女を探し出さなければ人間界が危ない。\nどうか手伝ってはもらえないだろうか……: If we don't find her, the human world is in danger. Could you help me…!
m920055.待ちたまえ！\n他の魔物が強くなってしまったら\nワシが最強ではなくなるかもしれ: Wait a minute! If the other monsters get stronger, I might not be the strongest any more.
m920055.心配いらないよ。\n人間の力だけで、どうしようもなかったらね。\nそんな時は、聖: Don't worry. If human power alone isn't enough, just borrow the spirit's strength.
m920055.必要なものは個々の力よりも\n集団として戦える連携かもしれんな。\nそうだ、次は: What they truly need may be teamwork, not just individual strength. Right, I'll grant them wisdom next.
m920055.恐怖、か……。悪くない。よかろう。\nお前の下に妖怪が集まるようにしてやる。: Terror, huh… Not bad. Very well. I'll make the youkai flock beneath you.
m920055.愚かな……。逃げられないのは貴様たちの方だ。\nここがどこなのか、そのくすんだ目:
Foolish… You're the ones who can't run away.
Take a good look at where you are with those dull eyes.
m920055.我らは、そこにいる王子を滅ぼす為に\n力を欲している！\nそして、我らは、既に魔:
We seek power to destroy the Prince there!
And we already bear demonic power within our bodies.
m920055.永久に揺蕩う深淵の闇の力よ、わが下に集え！\nわがしもべに敵を引き裂く鋭利なる刃:
Eternal, swirling abyssal darkness, gather beneath me!
I shall give my servants a razor-sharp blade to rend their foes…!
m920055.永久に揺蕩う深淵の闇の力よ、わが下に集え！\nわがしもべに敵を粉砕せし剛腕の力を:
Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness: Eternal abyssal darkness, gather beneath me!
I will bestow upon my servants the crushing might of steel arms to shatter foes…!
m920055.永久に揺蕩う深淵の闇の力よ、わが下に集え！\nわがしもべに敵を翻弄せし俊足の力を: Darkness of the abyss that drifts forever, gather beneath me! Grant my servants the swift, bewildering speed to confound their enemies…!
m920055.永久に揺蕩う深淵の闇の力よ、わが下に集え！\nわがしもべに敵を貫き、\n焼き尽く: Darkness of the abyss that drifts forever, gather beneath me! Grant my servants the power to pierce their foes and scorch them with utter black flame…!
m920055.永久に揺蕩う深淵の闇の力よ、わが下に集え！\nわがしもべに絶大なる求心の力を与え: Abyssal darkness that forever drifts, gather beneath me! I'll grant my servants overwhelming, centripetal power!
m920055.永久に揺蕩う深淵の闇の力よ、わが下に集え！\nわがしもべに肩を並べ戦列を作る知恵: Eternal darkness of the swirling abyss, gather beneath me! I'll grant my servants the wisdom to form battle lines shoulder to shoulder…!
m920055.永久に揺蕩う深淵の闇の力よ、わが下に集え！\nわれは邪悪なる力を抱えし許されざる: Abyssal darkness that forever drifts, gather beneath me! I am an unholy being bearing wicked power. I'll bestow upon my servants a great blessing of darkness…!!
Eternal darkness of the swirling abyss, gather beneath me! I am the forbidden one bearing evil power. To my servants I bestow the curse of ruin and the blessing of darkness…!
m920055.海まで来てみたが、なかなか\n人間を根絶やしに出来るほどの\n強い力を持った魔物: I've come all the way to the sea, and yet there are no monsters strong enough to wipe out humanity.
m920055.無事に倒せてよかったです。\nでは王子、戻りましょう。: I'm glad we managed to defeat them safely. Now, Prince, let's return.
m920055.王子、\n油断されませぬよう、戦闘の準備を！: Prince, stay on guard and prepare for battle!
m920055.王子、あそこに人……、いえ聖霊でしょうか。\n魔物に襲われているようです。:
Prince, over there… no, a holy spirit, I think.
It looks like they're being attacked by monsters.
m920055.王子、あの動きには何か意味が\nあるのかもしれませんよ。: Prince, there may be meaning behind that movement.
m920055.王子、常闇の聖霊を見つけ……え！？\nあれはグレーターデーモン！！: Prince, I've found the Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness… what!? That's the Greater Demon!!
m920055.王子、彼女を助けないと！\nでも一体、どうすれば……。: Prince, we have to save her! But how…?
m920055.王子、鎧を叩き潰すのは得意分野だ。\nあいつの相手はあっしらに任せてくだせぇ。:
Prince, smashing armor is my specialty.
Leave that foe to us.
m920055.王子よ、常闇の聖霊を赦してくれて、ありがとう。: Prince, thank you for forgiving the Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness.
m920055.王子よ。\n聖霊たちの祝福で、あなたたちの力は\n普段の１５０％ほどまで上昇して: Prince, thanks to the spirits' blessings, your strength has risen to about 150% of normal.
m920055.王子！ 常闇の聖霊を見つけました！\nそれに側にいるのは……、オーク！？:
Prince! I found the Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness!
And beside it… an Orc!?
m920055.知っての通り、自分たち聖霊には元々人間に力を貸すという\n役目がある。: As you know, we holy spirits are originally tasked with lending power to humans.
m920055.知るか！ このうつけどもが。\n鬼刃衆とやらも所詮は人間か。\nやはり力を与えた:
I don't care! You fools.
Even the Oni Blade Squad are just humans anyway.
Giving them power was pointless.
m920055.私が目を覚ました時には傍にいたはずの闇の聖霊は\nすでにいなかった。: When I awoke, the dark holy spirit who should have been by my side was already gone.
m920055.聖霊の力を奪い尽くす忌々しいやつらよ。\n人間など……、皆いなくなればよいのだ…: You cursed beings who would drain the spirit's power! Humans… they should all just disappear…!
m920055.自分たちがどんなに人間たちに尽くしても\n徒に仲間たちの力が奪われるばかりの現実: No matter how much we serve humanity, we only see our comrades' power being taken away in vain, and we finally fell into despair.
m920055.良かった。どうかお元気で。: Glad to hear it. Take care.
m920055.貴様だけでは心もとないな。\nどれ、他の魔物にも力を与えてやるか……。: You alone aren't enough. How about I grant power to the other monsters as well…?
m920055.逃げたりしません。\n私たちも聖霊たちの力を借りているのです。:
We won't run away.
We're also drawing on the Holy Spirits' power.
m920055.邪魔者たちは手下のデーモンどもに任せるとしよう。\nさあ、お前はこっちに来い！\: I'll leave the meddlesome ones to my minion demons. Now, come over here! Give me more power, make me even more golden!
m920055.面白い、ならば力を授けてやってもよい。\nだが、まずは、そこの人間どもを本当に\:
Interesting. Then I may grant you power.
But first, show me you truly intend to annihilate those humans.
m920055.頼む常闇の聖霊よ！ 我々ダークエルフに\nエルフ族を倒すための力を与えてくれ！: Hear me, Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness! Grant us Dark Elves the power to defeat the Elf race!
m920055.馬鹿な……！\n私は人間たちを憎んでいるのだ！\n人間との約束など守りはせぬぞ！:
Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness: Ridiculous…!
I despise humans!
I won't keep any promise to them!
m920055.（……今だ！）\n常闇の聖霊よ！ 我らに力をくれ！:
(…Now!)
Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness! Grant us power!
m920055.？？\n（今人の声が聞こえたような……。気のせいか。）:
??
(I thought I heard a human voice just now… Was it my imagination?)

m920062.――……くぁッ、あ……はぁ、はぁ、私は……\nいま何が……宝剣の想念が急に入り込: —…ugh, ah… *pant*… I… what's happening… the sword's thoughts just rushed in… the spirit-tiger sage is nearby…
m920062.――ぐァッ……スクハ、なぜわしを拒む？\n莫邪よ、なぜじゃ！？ 宝剣は未だわしの: —Gua… Sukuha, why do you reject me? Mo Ye, why!? The treasure sword is still in my hand—what's… what is this!?
m920062.――っは、ぁッ、め、面目ありません。ですが\nもう大丈夫です。私はもう独りではな: …Ha, ah, I have no excuse. But it's alright now. I'm no longer alone. My friends are supporting this Sukuha!
m920062.――ッあ、く……か、干将は……ドコ……？\n干将に……アイタイ……。ワタシの夫…: —…where… is Ganjiang…? I want to see Ganjiang… my husband…
m920062.……あ、あの、本当に身体から雷が\n出ていますぞ？ バチバチって。: …Um, is it really lightning shooting out of my body? It's crackling.
m920062.……うおおおおおッ！！！\nち、力がみなぎってくるぞぉおっ！！！: …Uuuuu!!! The power's surging!! It's flooding through me!!!
m920062.……え？ 莫邪の剣が……鳴動している……？\nまさか――ッ！？: …huh? The Mo Ye sword… is resonating…? No way—!?
m920062.……くっ。貴様らの力をあまく見ておったわい。\nまぁよいわ。\nスクハの国は既に: …Damn. I underestimated your strength. Fine. Sukuha's nation is already mine.
m920062.……ぐ。こうなったら、力尽くよ。\n砂漠の戦士は臆さない！\n最後に頼れるのは鍛: …Ugh. If that's the case, I'll go all-out. A desert warrior never backs down! In the end, all I can rely on is my own hardened body!
m920062.……す、すごい。\nここまでの武人が、\n一国の王として現存するなんて……。: …i-incredible. To think a warrior like you still exists as a kingdom's king…
m920062.……はい……このスクハが、身命を賭して、\n貴方達を御守りします……もう二度と、: …Yes… I, Sukuha, will stake my life to protect you… so that the two of you will never be separated again… I promise…
m920062.あっ……！ くっそぉ、逃げ足だけは速いんだから！\n……ごめん、スクハちゃん、剣: Ah…! Damn, you're fast on your feet! …I'm sorry, Sukuha-chan, we couldn't retrieve the sword…
m920062.あれは、妖虎仙の配下にある妖虎……。\nやはり、追っ手を差し向けていたのですね。: That's a Yōko-sen's subordinate—another Yōko. So they did send a pursuer after us. To be found so quickly…
m920062.あんなところに虎が……！？\nきっと何処からか迷い込んだんだわ。\nあんなに沢山: A tiger over there...!? It must've wandered in from somewhere. So many of them—what do we do...?
m920062.いえ、これで良かったのです。\n宝剣に宿りし二つの魂は、こうして一つに\nなるこ: No, this is exactly how it should be. The two souls dwelling in the sacred sword have finally become one.
m920062.うぅ……はやく、ここから……。\n逃げなく、ては……。: …Ugh… quickly, get out of here… Can't… run…
m920062.うーん、狩った狩ったぁ♪\nさーて、こいつらどうしようかなー。:
Hmm, hunted 'em, hunted 'em♪
Now, what should we do with these guys?
m920062.え……そ、そうですか。\nそれは……いいかも、しれないですね。\nあはは……。:
Huh… i-indeed.
That might… actually be nice.
Haha…
m920062.え、ちょっと、ルナールさんッ！？\n待って下さい、私も一緒に行きます。\nお願い:
Eh, wait, Lunarl-san!?
Please, let me come along too.
I'm begging you, let me go!!
m920062.おい、見ろよ！\nあそこに誰か倒れてるぞ！？\n……ん、おいおい、女じゃねえか！: Hey, look! Someone's fallen over there! …huh, hey hey, it's a woman!?
m920062.おおっ！？\nなんだか面白そうなことしてるなっ？\n魔物倒すのか？ いいぞっ、力: Whoa!? That looks fun! Taking down monsters? Count me in, I'll lend my strength!
m920062.お前が国を取り戻したければ、\n何れまた見えよう。\nでは、さらばだ。: If you wish to reclaim your country, you'll see me again someday. Until then, farewell.
m920062.かような我が身をお助け頂いたこと、\nこの命ある限り、決して忘れはしません。\n: I will never forget how you saved someone like me. Before my longing overwhelms me, I'll take my leave.
m920062.かわい、そう？ 私は、民を想って、\n臣の想いを継いで、ここまできたのに……。\: Cute, is that so? I've come this far thinking of my people, carrying on my retainers' wishes… Are you saying I'm wrong?
m920062.きゃっ……もう何なのよ、この砂ぼこりは。\nふつうに進軍するだけで疲れちゃうわ。: …Eek… what's with all this sand dust? Just marching normally wears me out. The sun's blazing too. *huff* I feel like I'm gonna collapse…
m920062.ぐわあああっ！！\nなんだこれは！？\n痺れて回避が出来ぬ……！: Gwaaah!! What is this!? I'm numb—I can't even dodge!!
m920062.ここにこうしてエサをまいてっと……。\nうん！ これで準備はオーケーだよ！\nう: I'll just scatter bait here... Yeah! All set. We'll buy time and take down the tigers one by one.
m920062.ここら一帯の虎を全て討伐できたようですね。\nご助力、本当にありがとうございまし:
Looks like we've cleared all the tigers in this area.
Thank you so much for your help!
m920062.この奇跡は、新たな伝承となり語り継がれて\nいくことでしょう……こんなに嬉しいこ: This miracle will become a new legend passed down through the ages… I've never been this happy… *sniff*… *sob*…
m920062.これからの戦いはより苛烈さを増すでしょう。\n皆さんに傷ついてほしくないというの: The battles ahead will only get harsher. I honestly don't want anyone to get hurt, but I also need your help...
m920062.これを煎じて飲めば、\n魔神フールフールの力が手に入るのだ！: If we brew it and drink it, we'll obtain FoorFoor's power!
m920062.さ、山岳地帯……。\nまだまだ先は長そうね……。: Alright, the mountain region... Looks like we still have a long way to go...
m920062.しかし……私は姫……一国を担う者が、\n他国の者にすがるなど、我が民をおとしめる: But… I'm a princess… A ruler of a nation can't cling to a foreigner—it would disgrace my people… I can't…
m920062.しかし、大帝の望む宝剣を造るのは\nとても難しく、その宝剣の完成と引き換えに、\: But forging the emperor's desired sword was so hard that the couple perished when it was completed…
m920062.しっかりしてください！\n一体なにがあったと言うのですか？: Hold it together! What on earth happened?
m920062.じゃがわしがすぐに思い出させてやるわぃ。\n宝剣の担い手として、永劫の番いとなり: But I'll make you remember right away. As the bearer of the treasure sword, I'll become your eternal guardian, cherishing and pitying you until death.
m920062.すごい力だ……。\nビリビリしてきたぞ……！！\nまるで雷の茨が身体中を覆うよう: Such amazing power… It's tingling… It feels like lightning vines wrapping my whole body!!
m920062.そ、そのようなことは……\nすみません、実は少しだけ、\n本当に少しだけ怖いので: Well, that's not... I'm sorry, but actually I'm a little—just a little—scared.
m920062.そ、そんな馬鹿な……！ う、うろたえるな！\nたかがアリだ！ 崖に引っ付いてる間: No way… This can't be…! Don't lose your composure! It's just an ant! While it's clinging to the cliff, fire off long-range arrows! Please, Ars!
m920062.そうか、ならバシラの分も作ってやるぞ！\nお揃いはいいぞ。仲間だ！ そしたら、\:
Great, then I'll make one for you too, Bashira!
Matching outfits are awesome. We're comrades! Then we can hunt even more!
m920062.そうだなー。\nルナールみたいな、かっこいい感じの\nかぶり物にするのもいいな！:
Well…
A cool, stylish headpiece like Lunarl's would be nice!
m920062.そりゃそうだ。俺の経験則からいくと、\nこんな絶壁をよじ登ってくる魔物は存在しな:
That's right. From my experience, no monster can climb a sheer cliff like this.
Well, an easy advance—can't complain. Hahaha!
m920062.それに、こちらには『干将剣』があるのだ。\n逃げることなどできんぞ、皇女スクハ…: Besides, we have the Ganjiang Sword. There's no way you can escape, Princess Sukuha…
m920062.それにしても、おかしいですね……。\n私がここを通った時は、あの様な魔物は\nい: Still, it's odd… When I passed through here earlier, there were no such monsters…
m920062.そんなに慌ててどうしたの、バシラ？\n……あーなるほど、迷い虎かぁ。\n大丈夫、: Why the rush, Bashira? ...Ah, I see, lost tigers. Don't worry, leave the tiger hunting to me!
m920062.たすけて……ください……。\nもう……ひとりでは……逃げられない……。\n私……: Help… please… I can't… run away alone anymore… I… I… ugh…
m920062.だ、大丈夫ですか……？\n（前にも確かこんなことが……）: A-are you alright…? (I think I've seen something like this before…)
m920062.ちょ、ちょっとエレインさん！\nここは高地ですよ？\nあ、危ないですって……ひゃ: Hey, wait a sec, Elaine! This is high ground, you know? Ah, it's dangerous... Whoa!
m920062.ついに、ついに、ついに！\n……手に入れたぞ！: At last, at last, at last! …We've got it!
m920062.ついに山頂まできました。\n見晴らしの良い開けた場所です。\nお気を付けください:
We've finally reached the summit.
It's an open spot with a great view.
Please be careful.
m920062.ですがここを通らなくては、妖虎仙の許に辿り\n着けません……。本当に申し訳ありま: But we have to get through here to reach the spirit-tiger sage… I'm truly sorry for dragging you into this.
m920062.ですが危険な山道であるが故に、敵の襲撃は\n前方のみに絞られますので、迎撃は容易: Though the trail is dangerous, the enemy can only strike from ahead, so intercepting them will be easy.
m920062.ですが敵の動きが不自然です……。\n私達を警戒して距離をとっているのか、\nある: But the enemy's movements are odd… Are they keeping their distance out of caution, or… Either way, stay alert.
m920062.どうか、王子のその武勇を、\n私達の国の為に、お貸し頂きたい。: Please, lend your bravery, Prince, for the sake of our nation.
m920062.どうしようって、\nどうするつもりなのですか……？:
What do you mean, “what should we do”…
What are you planning to do?
m920062.どうってことないよ、こんなの。\nそれに、ベラなんかは自分から協力して、\nむし:
No big deal, it's nothing.
Besides, Vera even volunteered on her own—she's practically here to play.
m920062.どうでしょう、スクハさん？\n魔物が復活した今、残った者達は皆で\n手を取り合う: What do you think, Sukuha-san? Now that the monsters have revived, shouldn't the survivors all join hands?
m920062.どうやらここは魔界アリの巣と\n化しているようですね。: It seems this place has become a nest for those demonic ants.
m920062.なッ、何言っちゃってるのよスクハちゃん！\nあんまり私を見くびらないで。まだやれ: Hey, what are you saying, Sukuha-chan! Don't underestimate me. I can still handle this! Haa! Elaine the lancer, charging forward!
m920062.はぁ……はぁ、ど、どうよスクハちゃん？\nわ、私だってこれくらい、やれるんだから:
Haa… haa, wh-what do you think, Sukuha-chan?
I can handle this much too.
Don't underestimate me…!
m920062.はぁ。肝心な時に、目が回っちゃうなんて……。\n今度こそ……！ そりゃっ――\n: Haa. To get dizzy right when it matters… This time…! Of course— Ah, I'm dizzy again! Someone, please stop me!
m920062.はい。ですので、我が祖国へと向かうことで、\n妖虎仙と出会うのは必定。\nこのま: Yes. Therefore, heading toward my homeland means meeting Yōko-sen is inevitable. Continuing on is the fastest route.
m920062.はいっ。\nもうすぐ山岳地帯が見えてくるはずです。: Alright! We'll be seeing the mountains soon.
m920062.はひぃー。もうヘトヘトだよ……。\n喉もからからだし！\n砂漠なんて大っ嫌い。: Haa— I'm exhausted… My throat's dry! I hate the desert.
m920062.ひっ……！ み、皆さん、あれを！\n崖にびっしりと魔界アリが……！: H-huh…! Everyone, look! The cliff is swarming with demonic ants!
m920062.ふぅ。\nようやく中腹くらいかしら。\nもうちょっとだね。頑張ろう！: Phew. I think we're finally halfway up. Just a bit more. Let's push on!
m920062.ふぉっふぉっふぉ、見つけたぞ皇女スクハ。\n干将もさぞや嬉しかろう。見えるか？:
Fo-fo-fo, I've found you, Princess Sukuha.
Ganjiang must be thrilled. Can you see? You and my wife. Ah… it's almost time…
m920062.ふぉっふぉっふぉ。\nそう泣くでない。これよりわしらは永久に結ばれ\n決して離れ: Fo-fo-fo. Don't cry like that. From now on we're bound forever and will never part.
m920062.ふぉっふぉっふぉ。干将が荒々しく泣きよるわ。\n宝剣同士はひかれ合う……逸話に違:
Fo-fo-fo. Ganjiang cries out wildly.
The treasure swords attract each other… just as the legend says,
truly a strange mystery.
m920062.ふふーん、どうよスクハちゃん？\n王子ってとっても頼りになるでしょ？: Hehe, what do you think, Sukuha-chan? The Prince is super reliable, right?
m920062.ほっほ。待たれよ砂漠の猛者よ。\nアリの硬い外殻を打ち破るには魔法が有効じゃて。: Ho ho. Hold your horses, desert tough-guy. Magic's the way to shatter that ant's tough carapace.
m920062.まあいいや。これぜーんぶアタシのだ。\nにしし、王子にも毛皮で何か作って\nやろ:
Whatever, it's all mine now.
Heh, I'll even craft something from fur—maybe for the Prince too.
What a great day…♪
m920062.まさか魔界アリが現れるとはのぅ。\n千年戦争の時に封じられ滅びたと思っておったが: Who would've thought demonic ants would appear? I thought they were sealed away and perished during the Millennium War, but we've run into some troublesome ones.
m920062.まるで磁石よね。\nどうしてそんな不思議な力が宿っているの？: It's like a magnet. How does it hold such a strange power?
m920062.む、無念……。\nつ、次こそは必ず……！: Hmph, frustrating… Next time, for sure…!
m920062.もう、泣かないの！ スクハちゃん！\n……でも……ぐすっ……よかった……、\n本: Stop crying, Sukuha-chan! …But… *sniff*… I'm so glad… really glad!
m920062.もうすぐ、この砂漠地帯を抜ける事が出来ます。\nそれまで、もう少々のご辛抱をお願: We'll be out of this desert soon. Please bear with us a little longer.
m920062.もうやってるって！\nでも外殻が硬すぎて、矢が刺さらねえ！: I'm already on it! But its shell's too hard—our arrows won't pierce it!
m920062.もちろんです！\n力を合わせ、必ずや妖虎仙を討ち払い、\n干将剣を取り返しましょ: Of course! Together we'll defeat the demon tiger and reclaim the Ganjiang sword!
m920062.やつの手にする剣が、\n急に光り始めたぞ……どういうことだ？: The sword in his hand suddenly started glowing… what's going on?
m920062.ようやくお目にかかれましたな、皇女スクハ。\nそして、愛しの我が対極――莫邪どの:
At last we meet, Princess Sukuha.
And my beloved opposite—Lord Mo Ye.
m920062.よかったね、バシラ。\n出来たらちゃんとあたしにも\n見せてよね？ それじゃあね:
Nice work, Bashira.
When you've made it, show it to me, okay? See you later.
m920062.んー？\nなんだ、バシラのやつ、\n自分の取り分も置いて行っちゃったぞ？:
Hmm?
What's up, Bashira…
You left your share behind?
m920062.ん？\nもしかしてお嬢ちゃん、\n高いところが苦手なのか？: Hmm? Could it be, miss, that you're not fond of heights?
m920062.アタシも手伝いますよ！ この踊りで魔物\nだって見惚れさせてみせま――わわッ！: I'll help too! With this dance, I'll even make the monster stare in awe—Whoa! My head's spinning… Who…? Someone… stop me!
m920062.ウソでしょう……？\nいったいどれだけの数を相手にしなきゃ\nいけないって言うの: You're kidding…? How many of them are we supposed to face?
m920062.エレインさん……。\n（とても疲れているはずなのに、\n本当になんとお礼を言って:
Elaine...
（Even though she's supposed to be exhausted, I really don't know how to thank her…。）
m920062.エレインさんの勇姿、しかとこのスクハの目に\n焼き付けました。その武勇と知略ゆえ:
I've firmly etched your brave figure, Elaine, into my eyes.
Because of your valor and wit, you truly are worthy companions of that brave Prince.
m920062.グルルル……。\n見つけたぞ、皇女スクハ……。\n貴様は我らから逃れることなど出: Grrr… I've found you, Princess Sukuha… You'll never escape us.
m920062.スクハさんが宝剣を所持している限り、\n剣同士の因果によって互いを引き合い、\n: As long as you hold the treasure sword, the fate of the swords will draw us together, so we'll inevitably meet, right?
m920062.スクハさん？ だ、大丈夫ですか？\n干将……？ まさか宝剣に宿る魂が、\nスクハ:
Sukuha? Are you okay?
Ganjiang…? Could the soul residing in the treasure sword be affecting you…?
m920062.スクハちゃん！ 宝剣の意思にのまれちゃ\nだめだよ……あなたは一国の王女なんでし: Sukuha-chan! You mustn't let the treasure sword's will consume you… you're a princess of a kingdom! Pull yourself together!
m920062.スクハを匿ったやつらが何者かは知らんが、\nそう遠くへは行けまい。: I don't know who hid Sukuha, but they won't get far.
m920062.タイミング悪ぅ……。\nまあいいわ、憂さ晴らしに一暴れしてやるわよ！: Bad timing… Fine, I'll let off some steam and go on a rampage!
m920062.バカなこと言ってんじゃないわよ！\nひとりで全部背負い込んで何を考えてるの？\n: Don't be ridiculous! What are you thinking, taking all this on by yourself? Your people and retainers will suffer.
m920062.一つの宝剣に、二つの魂を宿すことで、新たな\n伝説を紡いでいく……スクハさんの想: By housing two souls in a single sacred sword, we'll weave a new legend… I'm delighted we could honor Sukuha's wish. Prince, thank you for all your hard work.
m920062.中には邪悪な念に囚われ悪の手先になり果てる\n「邪仙」と呼ばれる者達がいるのです: But some become trapped by wicked thoughts and turn into minions of evil, called “evil immortals.” Yōko-sen is one of them.
m920062.二対の宝剣は、その刃を揃えることで大いなる\n力を発揮すると言い伝えられ、妖虎仙: Legend says that when the pair of swords align, they unleash great power, so it was clear Yōko-sen was after that mystery.
m920062.今まで自分を追いつめていたのでしょうね。\nスクハさんの為にも、しばし休憩をとり: You've been cornering yourself all this time, haven't you? For Sukuha's sake, let's take a short break and devise a strategy against Yōko-sen.
m920062.仙人は長年の修行によって、\n人智を超えた術を会得し、その力によって\n時には人: Immortals, through years of training, have mastered techniques beyond human understanding, and sometimes they use that power to help people…
m920062.伝令！\n斥候部隊が敵影を確認。\n恐らく妖虎仙の追っ手かと思われます。: Messenger! Scout units have spotted enemy movement. Likely a pursuer of Yōko-sen.
m920062.何とか敵を退けたようですね。\nさあ、一刻も早く、彼女をこちらに運びましょう。: It seems we managed to push the enemy back. Let's get her over here as quickly as possible.
m920062.依然として、険しい山道が続いていますね。\n一歩踏み外せば谷底へと落ちるのは必至:
The mountain path remains treacherously steep.
One misstep and we'll tumble straight down the gorge…
Everyone, stay alert as we move forward.
m920062.先ほどから、微弱ながらも莫邪の剣から\n何か不思議な力を感じています。\nもしか: Since a while ago I've been feeling a faint, mysterious power emanating from Moja's sword. Could it be the spirit-tiger sage…?
m920062.前方に敵の姿を確認！\nどうやらまた、妖虎のようです！: Enemy spotted ahead! Looks like another tiger spirit…
m920062.前方に敵影を確認！\nどうやら、こちらに向かってきているようです！: Enemy spotted ahead! Looks like they're heading straight for us!
m920062.協力させてくださいスクハさん！ このまま\n一人で逃げても、いずれ宝剣の因果が妖: Let us help you, Sukuha! If you keep running alone, the sword's destiny will inevitably draw Yōko-sen to it, and the blade will be taken.
m920062.危ないところを助けていただき、\n本当にありがとうございました。\n遅ればせなが: Thank you for rescuing me from that dangerous place. I'm truly grateful. Though it's a bit late, my name is Sukuha.
m920062.国から何とか持ち出せたのはいいのですが、\n宝剣同士は互いに共鳴し、引き合う力を: I managed to smuggle it out of the country, but the two swords are said to resonate and draw toward each other.
m920062.妖虎仙さまの為にも、必ずや貴様を……。: For the sake of Lady Yōko-sen, I'll make sure you…
m920062.妖虎仙との対決は近いですね、王子。\n干将莫邪の神秘と因果……そして妖虎仙。\n:
The showdown with the spirit-tiger sage is near, Prince.
The mystery and destiny of Ganjiang Mo Ye… and the spirit-tiger sage.
To settle everything, we must press on now.
m920062.妖虎仙の狙いは、我が国に封じられし\n二振りの宝剣『干将剣』と『莫邪剣』です。: Yōko-sen's goal is the two sealed treasure swords of my country, the Ganjiang Sword and the Mo Ye Sword.
m920062.妖虎仙は確実に私達に\n近づいているようですね。\n王子、お気を付けください！: Yōko-sen is definitely closing in on us. Prince, stay alert!
m920062.妖虎仙！？ 貴様に仇なす為、私は、わたしは、\nワタシは……か、干将……アナタ…:
Spirit-tiger sage!? To avenge you, I… I… I… Ganjiang… you… are you?
I… Mo Ye is… here.
m920062.宝剣同士が魂を導き合い、そして、スクハの\n持つ器を共存の為のよりしろと決めたの: The swords' souls are guiding each other, and they've decided that Sukuha's vessel shall become a conduit for coexistence. The holy light of guardianship fills the Mo Ye sword…
m920062.実は……祖国が妖虎仙という邪仙の襲撃にあい、\n臣下の助けのもと、何とか落ち延び: Actually… my homeland was attacked by the evil spirit Yōko-sen, and with my retainers' help I somehow escaped and ended up in that desert.
m920062.察しの通り、\nこれこそが魔神フールフールの身体の一部！\n我らに偉大なる力を授: As you guessed, this is a fragment of the demon god FoorFoor's body! It will grant us great power!
m920062.封印が解かれたのやもしれぬな。\nじゃが、一体何者が\n封印を解いたというのか…: Perhaps the seal has been broken. But who on earth could have undone it?
m920062.峻厳な山々が続きますね。\n皆さん足を踏み外さないように\nお気を付けください。: The rugged mountains stretch ahead. Please watch your step, everyone.
m920062.待ってくださいスクハさん！\nひとりで一体どこに行くというのですか！: Wait, Sukuha! Where on earth are you going alone?
m920062.後方より敵影を確認！\nこちらに向かってきています！: Enemy spotted from the rear! They're coming this way!
m920062.恐らくは間違いないかと。祖国に着くのが先か\n妖虎仙が現れるのが先か――えッ？: That's probably correct. Whether we reach the homeland first or the spirit-tiger sage appears first—huh? Suddenly, the Mo Ye sword starts to glow… eek—
m920062.惜しいのぅ、皇女スクハ。\n其方は、孤独と寂ばくこそが無二の\n化粧であったもの: How pitiful, Princess Sukuha. You thought loneliness and desolation were your only adornments…
m920062.慣れない山岳地帯での戦闘でしたが、\nなんとか無事に乗り切れましたね。\nお疲れ: Fighting in unfamiliar mountains was tough, but we made it through safely. Good job, Prince.
m920062.戯れるな、妖虎仙！ 私は、もう逃げません！\n宝剣が導いた新たな仲間との絆の許に: Don't toy with me, Youkosen! I won't run away any more! With the bond forged by the new comrades the sword led me to, I'll strike you down! Prepare yourself!
m920062.敵、すべて撃破しました。\nお疲れ様です、王子。: All enemies eliminated. Good work, Prince.
m920062.敵、すべて討ち払いました。\n王子、お疲れ様でした。: All the enemies have been swept away. Prince, thank you for your effort.
m920062.敵はすぐそこまで迫っているやもしれません。\n皆さん、気を引き締めていきましょう: The enemy might be right on top of us. Everyone, stay sharp.
m920062.敵影、すべて消失。\nやりましたね、魔界アリを退けたようです！\n本当にお疲れ様:
All enemy shadows have vanished.
We did it, looks like we've driven the demonic ants away!
Thank you for your hard work, Prince.
m920062.既に干将剣は奪われてしまいましたが、\n莫邪剣はこのように今なお、このスクハの\: The Ganjiang Sword has already been taken, but the Mo Ye Sword remains, still in my hands.
m920062.油断は禁物です。\nここは私達にとっては不慣れな地……、\nまだ見ぬ魔物がいるか:
We must stay vigilant.
This terrain's unfamiliar to us…
There could be monsters we haven't seen yet.
m920062.王子、スクハさんや彼女の国の為にも、\n妖虎仙を倒し、宝剣を取り戻すのです！\n: Prince, for Sukuha and her nation, we must defeat Youkosen and reclaim the treasure sword! Let's give it our all in battle!
m920062.王子、何とかこの死地を乗り越えましょう！\n戦いのご準備を。: Prince, let's get through this deathtrap! Prepare for battle.
m920062.王子、急ぎ戦いのご準備を。\nこの暑さで兵の体力が消耗しています。\nお気を付け: Prince, hurry and prepare for battle. The heat is draining the troops' stamina. Take care.
m920062.王子、私達も続きましょう！\n力を合わせ、この死地を脱するのです！:
Prince, let's keep moving!
Together we'll get out of this death-ridden land!
m920062.王子様たちの恩義に報いることはできませんが、\nここから一刻も早く立ち去ることこ: I can't repay the Prince's kindness, but leaving here as quickly as possible is the best gratitude I can offer.
m920062.皆さん、ありがとうございます！\nこれなら勝てる気がします。\nですが気を抜かぬ:
Thank you, everyone!
I think we can win now.
But don't let your guard slip. Come on, let's go!
m920062.皆さん、お喋りはそこまでです。\n即時、臨戦態勢をとってください！\n王子も、戦:
Everyone, that's enough chatter.
Get into battle formation immediately!
Prince, prepare yourself for the fight!
m920062.私達は砂漠の戦士。威張る事ではありません。\nここら一帯の魔物の討伐にしたって、: We are desert warriors. It's not about boasting. Even if we were to exterminate the monsters around here, it should originally be a matter for us to handle.
m920062.経験豊富とは言わぬが、\nこの老いぼれの魔法もなかなかのもんじゃぞ。\nさぁ、ハ: I won't claim to be seasoned, but this old man's magic still packs a punch. Come on, Hashim—let's give it a try.
m920062.聞こえる……干将莫邪の意思が……。\n我が剣に……干将の思念が……\n移って……: I can hear it… Ganjiang's will… entering my blade… Ganjiang's thoughts… transferring… into it…
m920062.莫邪剣を所持する限り、干将剣を持つ妖虎仙は\n私の居場所を突き止め、追っ手を仕向: As long as I possess the Mo Ye Sword, Yōko-sen, who holds the Ganjiang Sword, will pinpoint my location and send pursuers. That's why I must go.
m920062.行くべき場所などありはしません。\nですが、歩みを止めるのはこの身が尽きる時。\: There's no place I'm supposed to go. But I'll only stop when I've given my all. If embracing Mo-ya and reaching the afterlife is my fate, then so be it.
m920062.見て下さい、スクハさんの宝剣も、\n同じような光を放っています……これは？: Look, Sukuha's treasure sword is also emitting a similar light… what does this mean?
m920062.見直した？ ふふーん、じゃあ当分は真剣に\nやるのやーめた……って言いたいところ: You've changed your opinion of me? Heh, then I could say I'll stop taking things seriously for a while… but the showdown with the spirit-tiger sage is right around the corner, right?
m920062.話はこの危機を乗り切ってからですね。\n王子、兵のご采配をお願いします！: We'll discuss this after we get through this crisis. Prince, we need your orders for the troops!
m920062.詳しい事は私も存じ上げないのですが、\nその昔、当時の我が国の大帝が、名工の夫婦: I don't know the details, but I've heard it was commissioned by our great emperor back then, made by a master-craftsman couple.
m920062.謝ることはありません。\nかくいう私も、砂漠と勝手の違うこの地に、\nやや不安を: No need to apologize. I, too, feel a bit uneasy in this land that's so different from the desert.
m920062.足場は悪いし、勾配はきついし……はぁ。\nスクハちゃーん、私もう疲れちゃったよぉ: The footing's terrible and the slope is steep... *sigh* Sukuha-chan, I'm exhausted. Carry me!
m920062.迷惑をかけ、無礼を重ねているのは百も承知。\nですが、あなたたちを頼る\nと、私: I know I've been a burden and rude, but I've decided to rely on you.
m920062.随分と高い場所まで登ってきましたね。\nいよいよ山道も佳境のようです。: We've climbed quite high, haven't we? The mountain path is really reaching its climax.
m920062.馬鹿なッ！！\nわしの干将の剣の力が……無くなった、じゃと！？: Impossible!! The power of my Ganjiang sword… is gone!?
m920062.騎乗の身のくせに何をへばることがあるのだ？\nまあ砂漠での行軍を俺と比べるのは酷: What are you whining about, being on horseback? Well, comparing desert marching to me is harsh… Experience is different, you know. Gahaha!
m920062.魔物のせん滅を確認。\n王子、やりましたね。: Monster extermination confirmed. Prince, we did it.
m920062.魔物の姿を視認しました！\n周囲の経路は狭く、\n戦闘は避けられそうにありません: We've spotted a monster! The paths around are narrow, there's no way to avoid a fight!
m920062.（やつらの攻撃を待ち、\n我らの間合いに入ったところを、必死の歯牙で\n一気に喰: (We'll wait for their attack, and when they get into our range, we'll tear them apart in one bite…)
m920062.（先の戦でのやつらの戦いぶりを見る限り、\nうかつにこちらから手を出すのは下策…: (Judging by how they fought in the previous battle, striking recklessly would be a poor move…)

m920097.――……おっと、そういう訳にはいきませんね。\n流石に軍の設備内とあっては、\n: ――…Oops, that won't do. Since it's inside the army's facilities, it'll be hard to intervene.
m920097.――あ、アリーセ殿！ \nここ、こちらにいらっしゃいましたか！\nた、たたた大変: —Ah, Lady Aleese! You're here, right? It's… it's a terrible situation, His Majesty!
m920097.――あのフードを被った人には見覚えがあります。\n確か闇の組織の構成員。何故こん: —I recognize that hooded figure. He's definitely a member of the Dark Organization. Why is he here…?
m920097.――おっし、こっちは終わったぜ。\nこれでいつでも……っと、そっちも取り込み中だ: —Alright, that's done. Now we can… wait, you were also pulling something in? Sorry I couldn't lend a hand.
m920097.――お前達、こんな所で何をしている。: ——What are you doing here, in a place like this?
m920097.――ちっとだけ待ってな。\nすぐ確認を済ませっからよ。:
Just hold on a moment.
I'll finish the check right away.
m920097.――ふははは！ 見つけたぞ、白の皇帝！！\nこいつの命が惜しければ、その剣をこち: ——Fuhahaha! I've found the White Emperor!! If you value his life, hand over his sword! That sword belongs to me!
m920097.――もうすぐ帝国につくぞ。\nそろそろ降りる準備でもしておけ。: We'll be arriving at the Empire shortly. You should start getting ready to disembark.
m920097.――セフィーレ様、どうやらこの辺りには\n神獣の卵はないようです。一通り捜索して:
—Lady Sephire, it appears there are no divine-beast eggs around here.
We've scoured the area, but feel no presence.
m920097.――レオナ様、既に包囲網は完了しております。\nどこに逃げようと、捕まるのは時間: —Leona, the encirclement is complete. No matter where he runs, capture is only a matter of time.
m920097.――レオナ様が向かわれたのはこの辺りです。\n陛下も、レオナ様と共に\n戦線に出: —Lady Leona headed this way. I've heard His Majesty also went to the front with her.
m920097.――皇帝はこの付近に隠れている筈だ！\n必ず探し出し捕まえろ！ \n奴の首を、あ: —The Emperor should be hiding nearby! Find him and capture him! Bring his head before that person!
m920097.…………ちっ。聞かれていたのか。\nバレてしまってはしょうがない……！: …Tch. So you heard. Can't help it now that I'm exposed…!
m920097.……あぁ！ 見えましたよ、王子。白の帝国です！: …Ah! I can see it, Prince. The White Empire!
m920097.……いえ、私達も協力致します！ \n王子、魔物に襲われている女性もいるようです。: …No, we'll help too! Prince, there are women being attacked by monsters. Let's rescue them at once!
m920097.……えぇ、その通り。此度の事件は皇帝、\n貴様をその座から失脚させるべく私が仕組: …Yes, exactly. This whole affair was orchestrated by me to dethrone the Emperor—you.
m920097.……こんなんじゃ全然物足りない！\nもっともっと、強い相手と沢山戦って、\nワク:
…This isn't satisfying at all!
I want to fight stronger opponents, a lot more, and feel the thrill!
m920097.……しかし、いつ見ても\n帝国の飛空船とは凄いものですね。\nこれほどの大きさの: …But, no matter how many times I see them, the Empire's airships are amazing. To think something that big can actually fly.
m920097.……そうでない者たちも居るようだがな。\nだが、良い演習となった。陛下も満足そう: …There are those who can't keep up, it seems. Still, it was a good exercise. Even Your Majesty seemed satisfied. Prince, see you in tomorrow's drills.
m920097.……そんな！ 何故剣をこちらに……！: …No! Why are you pointing your sword this way…!
m920097.……っと、すまんな王子。帝国について\n早々面倒な事に巻き込んでしまった。: …Sorry, Prince. I've dragged you into Imperial affairs right away.
m920097.……つまり、黒の軍団の暴走及び\n一連の件には闇の組織が絡んでいると。: …So the Black Legion's rampage and the whole affair are tied to the Dark Organization.
m920097.……との事だ。追って正式に辞令を出す。\nもちろんただ学んでくるだけではないぞ。: …That's settled. I'll issue the official orders shortly. Of course, it's not just about studying. Show them the power of our proud Imperial Knights!
m920097.……どうやら危ない所だったようですね。\nボリスさんがいなかったらどうなっていた: …It looks like it was a dangerous spot. Who knows what would've happened without you, Boris. Thank you, Boris.
m920097.……なるほど、事情が見えました。\nあの方が一連の事件の……。: …I see, the situation becomes clear. He's the one behind this whole incident…
m920097.……なんだその薬は？ \nそんな薬私は知ら……待て、\n瓶が既に空なのは、貴様ま: …What's that potion? I've never heard of it… Wait, the bottle's already empty— you didn't…?
m920097.……なんとか片付きましたね。: …We managed to get it sorted out.
m920097.……はい。黒の軍団の兵舎が何者かに破壊され、\n魔物達が街へと放たれてしまったと: …Yes. The Black Legion's barracks were destroyed by someone, releasing monsters into the city. Reports say the monsters have lost their reason and are rampaging.
m920097.……ふっ。話が早くて助かるな。\nさぁ構えろ王子、さっさと始めるぞ。: …Heh. Good, you're quick. Take your stance, Prince, and let's get this started.
m920097.……まぁ、お話はこれくらいにしておきましょう。\n組織の為、私は私の仕事を果たさ: …Well, that'll be enough talk for now. For the sake of the organization, I'll do my job. Everyone, unleash the monsters you prepared.
m920097.……まさかこんなに上手く行くとはな。\nこの混乱がチャンスだ！ 者共、王子の首を: …I never imagined it would go so smoothly. This chaos is our chance! Everyone, aim for the Prince's head!
m920097.……む？ 私に薬をよこした研究者からは、\n投与して問題ない薬だと聞いていたが。: …Hm? The researcher who gave me the potion said it was safe to use. I even have the paperwork… here it is.
m920097.……もしそうであるならば愚かな事だ。帝国に仇なし\nタダで済むと思っているのなら: …If that's the case, it's foolish. If you think you can get away with harming the Empire for free, we'll show you just how naive that idea is.
m920097.……一体どういうこった。\nなんで騎士の姉ちゃんが、\nあのハゲに捕まってやがん: …What on earth is happening? Why is the knight's sister captured by that bald guy?
m920097.……一体何が狙いだ。: …What on earth is the goal here?
m920097.……事情は把握しました。\nこの場の魔物は我々が対処致します！\nアリーセさん、: …I've understood the situation. We'll handle the monsters here! Aleese, Rute, you all go ahead!
m920097.……仕方がない。後日疲弊した奴らと\n全力で戦えないではつまらんからな。: …Fine. It'd be boring if I can't go all out against those exhausted fools later.
m920097.……何を言っている、\n皇帝陛下ならここにおられるぞ。: …What are you talking about? If it's His Majesty, he's right here.

…Foolish children of humans. Very well.

m920097.あぁ……まさかアイギスの神器の力をこの目で、\nいや、この身で味わう事が出来る日: Ah… I never imagined the day I'd get to experience the power of Aegis's relics with my own eyes—no, with my own body. Fascinating, a phenomenon worth investigating!
m920097.あぁ……今日は演習初日、まずは\n軽い腕ならしのつもりだったのだがな。: Ah… It's the first day of the exercises, I was only planning a light warm-up.
m920097.あぁ、なんとかな……メフィスト、ヘルミーネ！\nいつも言ってるだろう、何かの実験: Ah, we made it… Mephisto, Helmine! I keep telling you, before you run any experiment you must follow the proper procedures and get approval!
m920097.あぁ、基本的には問題なかったんだけどよ、\n一ヶ所まるで素人がやったみてーな\n: Yeah, everything was fine overall, but I found a spot that looked like a total amateur did the maintenance.
m920097.あぁ、心得た。国に戻り次第、\n技術者達に伝えておこう。: Understood. As soon as we return to the capital, I'll inform the engineers.

m920097.あぁ、迅速に頼むぞボリス。\n……すまんな、\nこのような所で道草を食わせてしま:

…Sorry for making you waste time here.

Then, the Kingdom and the Empire's
"Second Joint Military Exercise" will now begin!

m920097.おーっしおめーら、着陸態勢に入るぞ！\n少し揺れっから気を付けときな！: Alright, everyone, get ready to land! It might get a little bumpy, so watch your step!

m920097.くっ……仕方ない、ここは退くぞ！: Damn… can't be helped, we have to fall back!

Later, bye-bye!

m920097.こちらの準備は整ったようですね。\n……帝国の皆さん、そちらはどうですか？: Looks like we're ready on this side. …Imperial forces, how are you doing over there?
m920097.この国の主義は「力こそ絶対」武力こそないが、\nその政治手腕を評価し、伯爵の地位: This country's doctrine is "might makes right"—though they have no force, we still value their political skill and granted them the title of Count. So you're dissatisfied?
m920097.この薬……その手に持っている瓶の事でしょうか？: This potion… you mean the bottle you're holding?

m920097.これは……確かに、使用を\n正式に受理した書類のようだが……そもそも\nこのよう: This… looks like an official approval document, but I never heard anything about developing something like this.

m920097.これほど充実した戦いが出来る相手、\nそうそう出会えるものでは無い。\nさあ、ま: It's rare to find opponents who give such a fulfilling fight. Come on, I still want more sparring!
m920097.これ以上は明日以降の演習にも\n影響が出そうですね……賢明な判断かと。: Pushing further would affect tomorrow's drills… a wise decision.

m920097.どうやらついたようだな。\n滞在中は案内のものをつけよう、\n演習まで帝国の中で: Looks like we've arrived. While we're staying, let's assign a guide. You should tour the Empire before the exercise begins.

m920097.なんという卑劣な真似を……そのような事、\nさせる訳には参りません！: How despicable… We won't let you get away with something like that!

m920097.なんとも頼もしい限りですね。王子、折角です。\n帝国までの空の旅を楽しみましょう: How reassuring, Prince. Since we have the chance, let's enjoy the flight to the Empire.
m920097.はぁ……はぁ……大変な目にあったわ。: Haa… haa… That was a close call.

m920097.はい。今後の課題とさせていただきます。: Understood. We'll make that our future task.
m920097.はっ！ ……この手を放せ、痴れ者め！！: Hah! …Let go of me, you fool!!

m920097.ばかもん！ 冷静に分析している場合か！: Fool! This isn't the time for calm analysis!

m920097.まさかその者がアイギスの神器保有者とは。\n全くあの時気付いていれば……私とした: To think that you're the bearer of Aegis's sacred relics… If only I'd realized it back then… How ignorant, how shameless of me.

m920097.まだハッキリとは言えん。だがメフィストに渡された薬、\nあの薬は魔物の理性を失わ: Nothing concrete yet. But the drug handed to Mephist was a type that strips monsters of their reason. It's safe to assume a similar drug was used this time.
m920097.まちやがれ！ ……って、もう遥か遠くにいやがる。\n見た目によらずなんちゅー足の: Hold it! …but he's already far away. He moves faster than he looks.

m920097.ようこそ王子、白の帝国へ。: Welcome, Prince, to the White Empire.

m920097.ッ！？ ベラート伯爵、\n陛下の身に何かあったのですか！？: Huh!? Count Beradt, what happened to His Majesty!?
