It's not really a trouble.
Just a tiny oddity in the power meter.
m920097.バーロー、俺の操縦する船で\nどうもこうもなるわけねーだろ。俺がいる限り、\nよ: Damn it, nothing's going to go wrong on a ship I pilot. As long as I'm here, you can rest easy.
m920097.ベラートか、すまんが事情を\n細かに説明している暇はない！\n急ぎ戦える者をこち: Bellart— sorry, there's no time to go into details! Send any fighters you have over here immediately!
m920097.ベラートがアリーセを？ \n……成程、上手くいっているようだな。: Beradt took Aleese? …I see, things are going smoothly for them.
m920097.ボリス、何か原因は判ったのか？: Boris, have you figured out the cause?
m920097.ボリスさん、急な不時着でしたが。\n何かトラブルでも？:
Boris, this emergency landing…
Is there any trouble?
m920097.モーティマさん、腕がブルブルしてますよ。\n無理はしない方が良いかと。: Mortimer, your hands are shaking. You'd be better off not pushing yourself.
m920097.ルーテ、貴方が声を荒げるとは珍しいですね。\n……それほど火急な事態という事です: Rute, it's rare to hear you raise your voice. …Is the situation that urgent?
m920097.ヴルムさん、深追いは危険です。\n……天使達の脅威は去りました。\nひとまずはこ:
Wurm, pursuing them further is dangerous.
…The angels' threat has passed.
For now, this will do.
m920097.人の子にしては中々やるようですね。\nでは私も少々本気を――:
For a human child, you're doing quite well.
Now let me get a little serious—
m920097.今この場から立ち去ると言うのであれば、\n幾何かの魂の猶予を与えましょう。ですが: If you leave this place now, we'll grant you some respite for your souls. However, if you stand in our way…
m920097.他国を知り、外から帝国を見る事で学べる事は多い筈だ。\n貴様の見聞が広がるのは、: By learning about other countries and seeing the Empire from the outside, you'll gain a lot. Expanding your horizons benefits the Empire. And it's also an apology for the trouble we caused the princes.
m920097.以前の演習では良いデータを取らせてもらった、\n今回も期待しているぞ。……総員、: The last drill gave us good data, and I'm counting on you again. …Everyone, hurry and equip the weapons imbued with magic from the Black Legion!
m920097.何か手違いでもあったのでしょうか？: Could there have been some mix-up?
m920097.何を言い出すかと思えば……貴様の血縁の者が\n王家だった事など、どれ程昔の事だ。: And you think you can claim the throne… Your blood ties to the royal line are ancient at best. It's not uncommon for distant relatives to have a claim.
m920097.何故このような所に人の子が……？: Why are children of humans here…?
m920097.俺の手間なんざ別に構いやしねーよ。\nけどな、飛行中に何かがあってからじゃ遅ぇん: I don't mind the extra work. But if something happens mid-flight, it's too late.
m920097.先ほどの戦いの最中、以前我々が相対した事のある\n闇の組織の構成員らしき者達の襲: During the battle earlier, we were attacked by members of the Dark Organization we've faced before. From their movements, it's clear they were after the Prince's head.
m920097.先ほど軍の研究者から受け取ったものだ。\n魔物に飲ませると力が増強する薬との事だ: It's what the army's researchers just gave me. Supposedly it boosts a monster's power when they drink it… Leona, why didn't you tell us you were developing something like this?
m920097.全くです。折角帝国を見て回る\n良い機会でしたのに……。: Absolutely. I was looking forward to touring the Empire…
m920097.判りませんが……どうやらまた\n王子の首を狙っているようですね。: I don't know, but it looks like they're after the Prince's head again.
m920097.動力計の異常も、俺じゃなきゃ見逃してたかもしれねぇ。\nこんな適当な整備は二度と: I might've missed the power-meter glitch if it weren't for me. We can't let such careless maintenance happen again—I'll make sure to give them a proper lecture.
m920097.各地に散った魔物の鎮圧には、指揮権を持つ階級の者\n総出で対処するよう指示が出て: We've ordered all officers with command authority to mobilize and suppress the scattered monsters. We were hoping you'd take command, Aleese… Wait!
m920097.合同演習の詳細な日取り、王子達を迎えるタイミングは\n軍の一部しか知らぬ事項。ま: Only a few in the army know the exact schedule of the joint exercises and the timing of the Prince's arrival. Could it be someone inside the ranks…? We'll need to investigate further.
m920097.商談だと？ 冗談を言うな。\n貴様のような怪しい輩と交わす商談など、\nこの国の: A “business deal,” you say? Don't joke. No one here would ever bargain with a shady scum like you!
m920097.報告ご苦労様です。\n貴方も配置についてください。: Thank you for the report. Please take your positions as well.
m920097.報告！ 前方より魔物の群れが接近中との事！: Report! A horde of monsters is approaching from ahead!
m920097.報酬がどーたら言ってやがったな。\nってーことは、俺らを狙うよう依頼した黒幕が\: They were talking about a reward, huh? So the mastermind who hired us must be somewhere out there, right?
m920097.客人を出迎えるのは人の礼儀なのだろう。\nそれに倣っただけに過ぎない……というの: Welcoming guests is a human courtesy, after all. I was merely following that custom… that's the official line.
m920097.帝国の方であるヴルムさんが、王国領内に\n天使が下りて来た事を報せに来てくれただ: Just having Wurm, an Imperial officer, come to inform us that angels have descended into the kingdom is already a huge help… Look!
m920097.帝国の精鋭騎士が貴様程度に抑えられる筈なかろう。\n自身を優位に思う者はベラベラ: Imperial elite knights wouldn't be subdued by someone like you. Those who think themselves superior chatter endlessly... Well then, it seems our important hostage is gone as well?
m920097.帝国は皇帝を頂点とする国家、\nその皇帝を守るべく普段は優秀な騎士達が\n身辺の: The Empire is a nation with the Emperor at its apex, and I've heard that elite knights usually guard the Emperor personally.
m920097.帝国を厄介に思う誰かしらが仕組んだ、\n罠って可能性もあるわね。: It could be a trap set by someone who finds the Empire troublesome.
m920097.帝国兵の皆さんみたいですね。\n彼らも皇帝を探しているのでしょうか？\n……それ: They look like Imperial soldiers. Are they also searching for the Emperor? …But they have a rather grim vibe.
m920097.帝国内部に謀反を企む愚か者がいるとの\nレオナ様の見立て通りだったか。\n……そ: So Leona's suspicion about a traitor plotting rebellion inside the Empire was right. …I wanted to believe there was no such person.
m920097.強い相手と戦いたくて帝国にいるのに、\n皇帝は全然相手してくれないし！\nもう、:
I joined the Empire to battle strong foes, but the Emperor never gives me a chance!
I've got so much pent-up frustration!
m920097.待ってくださいヴルムさん。ヴルムさんが巡回中に\n見かけたという天使の兵団、奴ら: Please wait, Wurm. Since we don't know the purpose of that angelic legion you spotted on patrol, it's too risky to go alone.
m920097.急ぎの事態のようですね。ですが目の前の連中が\nみすみす我々を見逃すとも思えませ: It looks urgent, but I doubt those guys right in front of us will just let us slip by… Aleese, we'll handle this—go ahead!
m920097.我々は構いません。それよりも、\nもしや此度の件について何か判ったのですか？: We don't mind. More importantly, have you learned anything about this incident?
m920097.我が名はメフィスト、真理を追い求める魔神。\n知識の探究の道にあり、物質界での拠: I am Mephisto, a demon in pursuit of truth. I walk the path of knowledge, and even in the material world I needed a foothold. So I've taken refuge here.
m920097.我らが陛下、祖国より賜りし命とは、\n帝国を守るインペリアルナイトとして絶対のも: Our sovereign's command, bestowed from the homeland, is absolute: to protect the Empire as an Imperial Knight.
m920097.捕まってしまいましたか。\n流石は皆さん、相変わらず見事な腕前ですね。: Caught, have we? As expected, you all continue to display impressive skill.
m920097.整備が可能な技術者や飛空船を維持する為の費用、\nそれに飛ばすための操縦士も必要: You need technicians to maintain it, the funds to keep it running, and pilots to fly it. And more importantly, a thing that big drawing attention in the sky—
m920097.明日からの演習に向けて、\nまずはごゆっくり休息をお取りください。\nこの度の戦: Before tomorrow's exercises, make sure to get some rest. Good work in the recent battle, Prince.
m920097.本当ですね～。一隻でも王国にあれば、\nとっても助かるんですけど……。: It really is… If we had even just one in the kingdom, it would be a huge help…
m920097.案内ありがとうございます！ \n道すがらアリーセさんに出会えたのは幸運でしたね。: Thanks for the guidance! Meeting you, Aleese, along the road was lucky. We almost missed each other.
m920097.此度の命にそのような命は含まれていませんが。\n……ですがそうですね、人を滅ぼす: This mission doesn't include such orders… But indeed, destroying humans is the greatest command we received from the gods.
m920097.気にするな、此度の合同演習の話を持ち出したのは\n我々だ。魔物達との戦いは激化の: Don't worry, we're the ones who brought up this joint exercise. The battles with the monsters are only getting more intense, so we have to cooperate with each other now.
m920097.演習とは言え手は抜きません！\n全力でやらせて頂きますよ！！: Even though it's just an exercise, I won't hold back! I'll give it my all!!
m920097.爆弾を持ったゴブリン達が街に散り散りに……まさか、\n帝国の街を破壊するつもりで: Goblins carrying bombs are scattering through the city… You can't be planning to raze an Imperial town!
m920097.王国との演習と聞き、我先にと戦いを望む者が\n後を絶たん、それも帝国きっての猛者: When we heard about joint drills with the kingdom, the empire's toughest warriors rushed in one after another… I hope it won't affect tomorrow's exercises.
m920097.王子、お疲れ様でした。\n演習とは言え、帝国の名だたる猛者たちとの激戦。\n流石: Prince, good work. Even though it's a drill, battling the Empire's finest was intense. Both sides look pretty worn out.
m920097.王子、この日を待ちわびていたぞ。\n貴様こそは全力を振るうに相応しい相手、\n我: Prince, I've been waiting for this day. You're truly a worthy opponent who can give it his all—let me show you the true art of my sword!
m920097.王子、アタシも一緒に戦うよ。\n銀竜の加護で皆を守るから！\n力を使いたい時は指:
Prince, I'm fighting alongside you.
With the Silver Dragon's protection, I'll shield everyone!
When you want to use your power, just give the order!
m920097.王子、帝国の皆さんの暮らしを知る良い機会です。\n折角ですので、是非色々と見て回: Prince, this is a great chance to learn about the lives of the Empire's people. Since we're here, let's take the opportunity to see everything we can.
m920097.王子、彼らの使う武器には毒が塗られている筈です。\n軽い傷であっても、倍の痛手を: Prince, their weapons are coated with poison. Even a minor wound will cause double the pain. It's best to confront them with the heavily armored units.
m920097.白々しい真似はやめておけ。\n先の発言はしっかりと聞かせて貰った。\n……陛下の: Cut the pretentious act. I heard your earlier words loud and clear. …You were talking about the Emperor's head, weren't you?
m920097.皆さん……ありがとうございます、\nこの御恩はいずれ必ず！\nベラート伯爵、陛下: Everyone… thank you. I'll repay this favor someday! Count Beradt, please see us to His Majesty!
m920097.皆さん、ご助力感謝します。\nこちらが片付き次第すぐ戻りますので！\nそれではま: Thank you all for your help. We'll return as soon as this is cleared! See you later!
m920097.皇帝、レオナさん。私達も手伝いますよ！\n王子、お二人と協力し\n帝国の街に平穏: Emperor, Leona. We'll help too! Prince, let's work together with you two and restore peace to the imperial city!
m920097.皇帝、傭兵上がりの貴様はこの国を治めるには\n値しない人間。この国を治めるのは、: Emperor, a former mercenary like you is unfit to rule this land. The one who should govern is someone of royal blood—me. Don't you agree?
m920097.目的が判らぬ以上、放置する訳には参りません。\nそれに人を滅ぼすという使命につい: Since we don't know your purpose, we can't just ignore you. And as for your mission to annihilate humanity, we will absolutely stop it.
m920097.目的は判らんがな。しかし王子達がこの国に来るのと\n同時に事を起こすとは、あまり: I don't know their motive, but the timing—right as the Prince and his party arrive—is suspiciously perfect.
m920097.確かルーテさんが仰ってましたね。\n指揮官階級以上の者総出で事に当たっていると。: I'm pretty sure Lieutenant Rute said that everyone of commander rank and above is dealing with it.
m920097.祖国からの命に従いあなた方の滞在中、\nその身の安全は命を賭して守り抜くと誓いま: Following the command from our homeland, I vow to protect your safety with my life during your stay. Please, feel at ease.
m920097.祖国に牙むくなど、帝国の騎士として恥ずべき行い。\n剣を納め、貴様達の裏にいる者: To turn one's teeth against the homeland is a disgrace for an Imperial Knight. Sheathe your sword, and if you spill the ones behind you, I'll give you a chance to explain. If you choose to resist—
m920097.私は大丈夫です。……それより申し訳ありません。\n客人の皆さんをこのような事に巻: I'm fine… More importantly, I'm sorry we dragged our guests into this.
m920097.私は王家の血筋ですぞ！ この国の全てを握るに\n値するのは私、そのような地位程度: I am of royal blood! I am the one worthy of grasping this entire nation; I could never be content with a mere title like that!
m920097.私も驚いた……あれであれば、何か別の使い道も\nあったかもしれん。お飾りの伯爵に: I'm surprised too… If that's the case, maybe there was another use for him. Keeping the ornamental Count around might've been a waste…
m920097.空での戦いは普段とは勝手が違いますね。\nしっかりとした兵の鍛錬と、練度も必要…: Fighting in the air is different from what we're used to. It takes well-trained troops and skill… So even with a ship, you can't just start using it right away.
m920097.結構だ。これは帝国内の問題、\n他国からの客人に頼っては帝国の面子が立たん。\n: That'll do. This is an internal Imperial matter; we can't rely on foreign guests to save face. …But we appreciate the sentiment.
m920097.船を整備するべく不時着したというのに、\n壊されてしまっては元も子もありませんね: We made an emergency landing to repair the ship, and if it gets destroyed there's nothing left. Prince, let's drive those monsters off.
m920097.色々ありましたけど、\n良い合同演習が行えそうですね。これを機に、\n帝国の皆さ: We've had a lot go on, but it looks like we can hold a solid joint drill. Let's use this chance to get to know the Empire folks better.
m920097.要人を乗せた飛空船が墜落すれば、信用を理由に\nその座から降ろす事もできると思っ: I thought that if the airship carrying important people crashed, we could use the loss of trust to strip them of their seats. Absolute power over the nation—could anything be more enticing?
m920097.見つけた！ お前達の目的が何か知らないけど、\nどうせ人間を滅ぼすとか言ってるん: Found you! I don't know what your goal is, but you're probably talking about wiping out humans, right? We won't let that happen!
m920097.貴方が噂に名高い王子殿下ですね。\n私はアリーセ、あなた方がこの国に滞在中の案内: You must be the famed Prince everyone's been talking about. I am Aleese, assigned to guide you during your stay and to ensure your safety.
m920097.貴様が人の出迎えとは珍しいなメフィスト。\n一体どういう風の吹き回しだ？: It's odd to see you greeting guests, Mephisto. What brings you here?
m920097.闇の組織は私達が引き付けます！\nアリーセさんは散ったゴブリン達を！: We'll draw the Dark Organization's attention! Aleese, take care of those scattered goblins!
m920097.闇の組織をけしかけたのは貴方でしたか。: You were the one who stirred up the Dark Organization, weren't you?
m920097.飛空船の整備不良も貴様が仕組んだ事か。\n狙いは皇帝の地位、本当にそれだけか？: The airship's mechanical failure—was that your doing? Your aim is the Emperor's throne; is that all?
m920097.飛空船を使用する前には念入りな\n整備を行っている筈なのだが……すまん、\n手間: We're supposed to do thorough checks before using the airship… Sorry for the trouble I caused.
m920097.飛行中に何かあったら取り返しもつかねぇ。\nしっかり見ておくに越した事はねぇだろ:
If something happens while we're flying, we won't be able to recover it.
We'd better keep a close eye on it.
m920097.魔物が蔓延る時勢の最中、街の人も活気づいていますね。\n帝国兵の皆さんが街を守っ: Even amid the monster infestation, the townsfolk seem lively. It's probably because the Imperial soldiers are protecting the city, giving everyone a sense of security.
m920097.魔物達にとっては格好の標的という訳だ。: Makes it a perfect target for the monsters.
m920097.黒の軍団が暴れていると聞き駆け付けたが、\nどうやらまた世話になってしまったよう: I heard the Black Legion was on the rampage, so I rushed over, but it looks like I'm needed again. Sorry for the trouble.

m920144.――あ、あたしも仲間に入れだと！？: ――Wait, I can join the group too!?
m920144.――あぁっ！ ちょっと！\n軍議中ですわよー！ 止まりなさいなー！！:
――Aah! Hey!
We're in the middle of a war council! Cut it out already!!
m920144.――いえ、私達には分かるかもしれません。\n彼らが開こうとしているのが天界の門で:
――No, we may be able to find them.
If they are opening the gate to the heavens.
m920144.――お、お待ちください！ ユージェン様！\n王子、報告です！ 王国周辺の村や砦に:
――P-Please, wait! Master Yuugen!
Prince, I have a report!
Knights of unknown origin have attacked
the villages and fortresses surrounding the kingdom!
m920144.――おや、もう準備万端のようですね。\n王子君も準備は出来ていますか？:
――Oh my, everything seems to be in order.
Are you ready, Prince?
m920144.――さぁ、天界の門よ開け。\n我らを次なる聖戦の地へ導き給え。:
――Now, open the gates of the heavens.
Guide us to the next battlefield of the holy war.
m920144.――そうはいかない。\nフィナンの魔力を渡すわけにはいかないのでね。:
――Not so fast.
We cannot afford to let Finan's magic power slip away.
m920144.――そうはさせないさ。\nフィナンは返してもらうぜ！:
――Not on my watch.
I'm taking Finan back!
m920144.――そこまで！\n模擬戦終わりです！:
――That's enough!
The sparring match is over!
m920144.――て、天界の門が、起動しない……だと……。\nなぜだ、やはり贄が足りなかったの:
——T-the Gate of the Celestial Realm……isn't activating…….
Why? Was the sacrifice not enough?!
m920144.――ふむ、アイギスを信仰する邪教の民か。\n信仰と洗脳を混同するとは、\nいささ:
??? : ――Hm, so you are a people of the heretical cult that worships Aigis.
Confusing faith with brainwashing…
Perhaps your knowledge is a little lacking?
m920144.――ぽぽん！ 化け化け情報網に反応ありぽん！\nみんな、戦闘準備をするですぽーん: ――poppon! Our intel network's picking up something! Everyone, prepare for battle, po—
m920144.――やれやれ、ここにいたのか信徒フィナンよ。\n儀式の贄を集めるという、\n聖な:
??? : ――Tch, so you were here, Believer Finan.
What are you doing in the middle of the sacred act
of gathering sacrifices for the ritual?
m920144.――トゥアン、危険です。\nフィナンを連れて下がってください。:
——Tuan, it's dangerous.
Take Finan and fall back.
m920144.――フィナン、何を考えているのかね。\n信仰に迷いは必要ない。\nさぁ、村人をさ:
――Finan, what are you thinking?
There is no room for doubt in faith.
Now, go take the villagers and offer them as sacrifices.
m920144.――フィナン！ 目を覚ませ！\nあたしの声が聞こえねぇのか！:
――Finan! Wake up!
Can't you hear me?!
m920144.――以上が、神聖騎士団を名乗る、\n白き鎧の騎士たちに関する報告です。: ――That concludes the report on the knights clad in white armor who call themselves the Holy Knights.
m920144.――信仰に我が身を捧げます……。\nこの身を、この魔力を、この生命を……。:
——I offer my body to faith…….
This body, this magic power, this life…….
m920144.――倒しても倒しても湧いてくるな。\nいったいこの魔物、どこから来てるんだ？:
――No matter how many I take down, more keep appearing.
Where are these monsters even coming from?
m920144.――制圧が遅いと思えば、\nまたアイギスの邪教徒に邪魔をされていたのか。:
――I thought our suppression was taking too long.
Are you Aigis cultists here to interfere again?
m920144.――準備を急げ、敬虔なる信徒たちよ。\n敵は魔王を討った王子だ。\nすぐにこの場:
――Hurry with the preparations, pious believers.
The enemy is the Prince who slew the Demon King.
He will find this place soon enough.
m920144.――異教徒、異教徒を見つけました……。\nアイギスを崇める邪教の信徒を……。:
??? : ――Heretic. We've found a heretic…
A follower of the heretical cult that worships Aigis…
m920144.――話し合いの最中に悪いな。\nここにフィナンと戦った奴がいるって聞いたんだが。:
――Forgive me for interrupting.
I heard one of you fought Finan.
m920144.――邪教たるアイギスの信徒を、滅ぼす者。: ——Heretics who would destroy the believers of Aigis.
m920144.――驚きましたわ……。\n英傑さまって、伝説上の人物ばかりですのに……。:
――I was surprised…….
The Heroes are supposed to be nothing but legends.
m920144.――魔物を滅せよ、異教徒を滅せよ。\n我ら神聖騎士団、信仰にて編まれた刃なり……:
??? : ――Destroy the monsters. Destroy the heretics.

Prince, for the sake of healthy club operations,

I see, a regular fan club……

To see you so diligently following that lesson…

m920173.たまには学園に、剣術指導に来てみるものですね。\nまさかコーネリアと戦う機会に恵:

m920173.だいたいそういうことだろう！\n王子、ごはんを食べた生徒にも注意するんだぞ！:

Prince, keep an eye on the students who've eaten, too!

m920173.なので、これからも大手を振って、\n王子のファン活動ができちゃいますよ♪:
So, we can continue our fan activities

I see… If that's what you're after,

Hold on! It's us, the Little Devil Girls Watchers Squad,

Minette-chan's desserts!?

m920173.はっ、いやテメェら、\n別にケイティ先生も喧嘩しにきたわけじゃ――:

Gya gya?

Hosted by Her Highness Sybilla!

Prince, before it spreads to the other students,

seem to be in the villain's position?)
m920173.（さすがいいんちょ、キレイにまとめましたね）: (As expected of our president, she wrapped that up nicely.)
m920173.（ついついノセられてしまったが、\nそろそろ誤解を解かないと大変なことに……！）:
(I got swept up in the moment,
but if I don't clear this up soon, it's going to get really bad……!)
m920173.（ですが、ゴブリン博士は、\nなぜか王子に友情を感じているようですが……）:
(But it seems Goblin Doctor
feels a certain friendship toward the Prince…)
m920173.（どうしてぇぇぇぇぇっ！！\nイングリッド！ ヒバリ！ 空気を読んでくれ！\n私:
(Why, why, why!!
Ingrid! Hibari! Read the room!
I just want to sharpen my sword skills normally!)
m920173.（ふふ、まるで師弟の会話ですね。\n本当にゴブリン軍団が、\n王国と共に歩んでく:
(Heh, it's like a conversation between a master and a disciple.
I really hope the Goblin Legion
will continue to walk alongside the kingdom…)
m920173.（ふふ、偽らざる本音ですよ）\nそれよりクレアさん、何だか外が騒がしくないですか:
(Hehe, I meant every word.)
Besides, Claire, don't you think it's a bit noisy out there?
m920173.（ファンクラブ、かぁ……。\nちょっといいなぁ……）:
(A fan club, huh...
I kind of like the sound of that...)
m920173.（彼らがそれを受け入れてくれるかどうかは、\n天界との戦いが終わるまで、分かりま:
(Whether they will accept that or not
remains to be seen until the war with the Celestial Realm is over.)

m920186.――『……こえますか？ 聞こえますか！？\nこちら魔術師ギルドです！ 聞こえます:
――…Can you hear me? Can you hear me!?
This is the Mage Guild! Can you hear—!?
m920186.――『あーあー、聞こえますか？\nこちら魔術師ギルド、フローガです！』: —“Ah-ah, can you hear me? This is the Mage Guild, Floga speaking!”
m920186.――ああ。\nこの聖槍には、今やこの世界全ての願いが宿っている。:
――Yes.
This holy spear now holds the wishes of the entire world.
m920186.――あの、助けていただいて、ありがとうございましたっ。: ――Um, thank you so much for saving me.
m920186.――あの子は来ませんよ。\nあなたに待っているのは、暗き死後の旅路のみ。:
――That child is not coming.
All that awaits you is the dark journey into death.
m920186.――い、生きて、る？\nお、王子！ 王子っ、ご無事ですか！？:
――A-are you… alive?
P-Prince! Prince, are you alright!?
m920186.――いや、どうやら大丈夫そうだ。\nあの子が召喚したガーゴイルが、\n召喚主たる:
――No, it seems she'll be alright.
The gargoyle she summoned
appears to be protecting her, its summoner.
m920186.――えぇ。そうでした。\n王子様は、決して諦めない方。\nだから私は、ここに来た:
――Yes. That's right.
The Prince is one who never gives up.
That's why I came here.
m920186.――お、王子っ！ 伝令です！\n城門の前に市民が押し寄せて、\nあ、あのっ、どう:
――P-Prince! A messenger!
The citizens have gathered at the castle gates,
a-and, what should we……!?
m920186.――おや？\n王子、上空から急速接近する影が！:
――Oh my?
Prince, a shadow is approaching rapidly from above!
m920186.――およそ考えうる限りの、\nあらゆる天変地異が起きていると言うべきでしょう。: —It would be fair to say that every conceivable natural disaster is occurring.
m920186.――お待たせしました！\n皆さん、ご無事ですか？: —Sorry to keep you waiting! Everyone, are you all safe?
m920186.――ぐぅ……ッ！？\n……ほう、予の障壁を消滅させたか……！:
――Guh……!?
……I see. So you've dispelled my barrier……!
m920186.――ここまで、何度戦ってきたのかしらね。\n王国は何度も私達の邪魔をして……。:
――I wonder how many times we've fought by now.
The Kingdom has been getting in our way so many times…….
m920186.――さぁ、物質界の諸君、終焉の時だ。: —Very well, citizens of the Material World. The time of your end has come.
m920186.――ずっと、考えていたのだ。\n真に守るべきものが何なのか。:
――I have been thinking about it for a long time.
What is truly worth protecting.
m920186.――そろそろクラールフ殿が\n天守より『破滅の力』を奪取した頃か？: ――Perhaps now is when Lord Kralhu has seized the “Power of Ruin” from the keep?
m920186.――だから、帝国の船を貸したのだ。\n遅いぞ王子。待ちくたびれた。: —That's why I lent the empire's ships. You're slow, Prince. I've been waiting long enough.
m920186.――つい先日のことです。\nずっと均衡が保たれていたはずの天界が、\nにわかに騒:
――A few days ago,

the heavens, which had been in a state of balance,

suddenly became chaotic.
m920186.――では、私が二柱の女神の依り代になりましょう。: Then, let me become the vessel for both goddesses.
m920186.――とうとう、この時が来たか。\n随分と、遠回りをしてきた気がするものだ。:
――So, this moment has finally come.
It feels like we took quite the long way around.
m920186.――なるほど、これまでとは違うようだ。\nならば予の次なる姿を見せてやろう。:
――I see, this is different from before.
Then let me show you my next form.
m920186.――なるほど、それなりの知恵はあるようですね。\nされど愚かなる人の子よ。\nこ:
――I see, you are not without your wits.
But alas, foolish children of men.
It is already too late for that.
m920186.――なるほど、魔王ガリウス討伐の報は\n真実だったようですね。\n人の身でこれほ:
――I see, the report of the Demon King Garius's defeat
was indeed the truth.
To possess such power in a human body.
m920186.――まったく、世話が焼ける。\nまさか飛空船が圧潰するとは思わなかったぞ。:
――Tch, what a hassle.
I never expected the airship to collapse like that.
m920186.――む？ サイラスよ、何か感じぬか？\n魔力の乱れ……いや、これは……。:
――Hm? Cyrus, do you feel that?
The magical energy is fluctuating… No, this is…
m920186.――キヒ。\nお前達が侵攻してくることは既に知っておった。\nならば出迎えてやる:
――Heh.
I already knew you would launch an invasion.
It is only fitting that I welcome you.
m920186.――キヒ。\n魔神共はさすがに気付くか……。\nだが、もはや手遅れというものよ。:
Kihii.
I suppose the demon lords were bound to notice…
But it is far too late for that.
m920186.――ギャギャ！\nウツテ！ アル！ ウツテ！ アル！！:
――Gyagya!
Hit it! Ar! Hit it! Ar!!
m920186.――ゴライア、カ。\nそんナ不意打ちデ、私ヲ倒せると思わぬコトダ。:
—Goliah, huh.
You really think a sneak attack like that could take me down?
m920186.――ゴライア。\nその不屈の闘志ダケは認めてヤロウ。\nダガ、此度の戦いは最早児:
――Goliah.
I'll admit your unyielding spirit is something to respect.
But this battle is no longer a child's game.
m920186.――ッ！\nあなたはこちらの秘策に気付いて……！！:
――Tch!
So you saw through our trump card……!!
m920186.――ッ！ お、王子殿下っ！\n白の帝国との通信魔法が途絶えました！:
――! P-Prince!
The communication magic with the White Empire has been cut off!
m920186.――ヌゥゥッ！？\nあれに見えるは王子達か！\n初戦で相見えるとは僥倖だ！: ――Nuuuh!? Is that the princes I see! To meet in the first battle is lucky!
m920186.――ホウ、未ダ諦めナイのか。\nだが、ここデその抵抗も終わりダ。:
――Hmph, you still refuse to give up.
But your resistance ends here.
m920186.――三女神の力が失われ、\nその遺物たる『神の楔』を奪い合う争いが始まった、と。:
――With the power of the Three Goddesses lost,

a struggle to seize the "God's Wedge," their relic, has begun.
m920186.――不可解。\n魔物が出現したと報告を受けた後、\nすぐに部隊を編成して駆け出し:
――Unbelievable.
As soon as I received the report of monster sightings,
I immediately formed a unit and rushed out.
m920186.――世界樹が、燃えてる……。\nうぅ、どうしてこんなことに……。:
――The World Tree is burning...
Ugh, why is this happening...
m920186.――今、その白の帝国から、\n通信魔法で定時連絡がありましたよ。\n聖槍の回収は:
――We just received a scheduled communication via magic
from the White Empire.
They say the recovery of the Holy Lance is going smoothly!
m920186.――何が起きた？\n魔王軍が退いていくぞ……。: —What happened? The Demon Army is retreating….
m920186.――何度お前達の力を試したと思っている。\nこの物質界において、\n予に抗しうる:
—How many times do you think I have tested your strength?
In this material world,
only the forces of the Kingdom and the Empire can stand against me…
m920186.――否。かつて守ったこの世界が、\nこうして滅びゆく様を見てもなお、\nどちらが:
――No. Even watching this world, which I once protected,
come to such a ruin,
I still do not know which path is correct.
m920186.――否だ、暗黒なる者よ。\n溺れる民め、どうやら悪知恵だけは働くらしい。\n天守: ――No, dark one. The drowning people seem only to rely on wicked cunning. The “Power of Ruin” was not hidden in the keep.
m920186.――嗚呼、星の声が聞こえる。\n何と美しい、調べなのだろうか……。:
――Ah, I can hear the voice of the stars.

What a beautiful melody……
m920186.――報告は以上です。\n各地の瘴気も急速に低減、\nもうしばらくすれば元通りにな:
――That concludes my report.

The miasma in each region is rapidly dissipating,

and it should return to normal soon!
m920186.――来い、デシウス。\n俺達の戦いに、ここで決着をつけよう。:
――Come, Decius.
Let's settle our battle right here.
m920186.――来たのか。\n無駄なあがきをするものだ。:
――So you've come.
What a futile struggle.
m920186.――気付いたから、だとも。\nガリウスめが神の一柱である以上、\n溺れる民たるお:
――Because I realized.
Now that Garius is one of the gods,
you, the drowning people, have reached for something.
m920186.――王子、各地の魔術師ギルドからの連絡です。\n各地の神殿への、避難民の収容は順:
――Prince, we have reports from the mage guilds in various regions.
The evacuation of refugees to the temples is proceeding smoothly.
m920186.――王子、来てくれるって信じてた。\nこれで、私達に敗北はなくなった。: ――I believed the Prince would come. Now we have no chance of defeat.
m920186.――王子よ、そして人の子らよ。\nこれより先は、人の力で歩んでいくのですよ。:
――Prince, and all children of man.
From this point on, you must walk forward by your own strength.
m920186.――王子様、世界樹の様子についてご報告を……っと、\n皆さまお揃いだったのですね:
――Prince, I have a report on the state of the World Tree... Oh,
I see everyone is gathered here.
m920186.――王子！\n前方よりゴブリンの群れが接近しています！:
――Prince!
A horde of goblins is approaching from ahead!
m920186.――異常事態……。\nまっ、まさか、世界樹の災厄の予言ですか……？:
――An abnormal situation…….

No, could it be…… the prophecy of the World Tree's calamity?
m920186.――確か、あなた方はこの浄化を、\n世界樹の災厄の予言、と呼んでいましたね。\n:
――I recall you calling this purification
the "Prophecy of the World Tree's Calamity."
Well then, let us show you the calamity itself.
m920186.――結論から言って、世界各地の被害は甚大です。: —To get straight to the point, the damage across the world is catastrophic.
m920186.――行くぞ、皆。\n王国を取り戻したあの時のように、\n今度は、世界を取り戻しに: —Let's go, everyone. Like when we reclaimed the kingdom, this time we'll reclaim the world.
m920186.――行くぞ王子、お前の力を見せてやれ。: —Let's go, Prince. Show me your power.
m920186.――誓いは果たした。\n俺たちの、勝利だ。:
――The oath has been fulfilled.
This is our victory.
m920186.――誓いを、果たす時が来た。: ――The time has come to fulfill that oath.
m920186.――逃げ遅れた市民か。\n……俺から離れるな、分かったか？: —A citizen who missed the escape. …Don't stray from me, understand?
m920186.――長い、長い戦いだった。\n英雄王の時代から続いた魔王との戦いは、\n今ここで:
――It was a long, long war.
The battle against the Demon King, which has continued since the era of the Hero King,
has now come to an end by our own hands.
m920186.――鬼刃姫様、水路より魚人の軍勢が侵入とのこと。\nセツナと妖怪衆が防衛にあたっ: ――Oni Blade Princess, troops of fishmen have breached the waterways. Setsuna and the youkai are defending.
m920186.――魔王ガリウス。\n全てお前の狙い通りということか。:
—The Demon King, Garius.
So it was all part of your plan.
m920186.――魔王ガリウスの魔力が、崩壊していきます！！: ――Demon King Garius's magic power is collapsing!!
m920186.――魔王城、だっけか。\nまったく、そんな愉快な名前を付けたのは誰だよ。\nまる:
――The Demon Lord's Castle, was it?
Honestly, who came up with such a cheerful name?
It sounds like a fairy-tale hero's legend.
m920186.…………なるほどな。\n連中、撤退を装って俺達をここに引きつけたのか。:
…………I see.
They feigned a retreat to lure us here.
m920186.…………！！\nダーク王子さんの剣から、聖槍に光が……！:
…………!!
Light from the Dark Prince's sword…… is flowing into the holy spear……!
m920186.…………！？\n地脈が安定しました！\nすごい……これが三女神の力……！！:
…………!?
The ley lines have stabilized!
Amazing…… this is the power of the Three Goddesses……!!
m920186.……あ、ああ……予の、魂が……。\n予の力の形が……崩れ、壊れていく……。:
……Ah, ahh…… my soul…….
The form of my power…… is crumbling, shattering…….
m920186.……ああ。\nお前が守りたかった世界は、必ず俺が守り続けていく。:
……Yes.

I will keep protecting the world you wanted to save.
m920186.……あなたが、天界へ続く門から\n現れたというのは、本当ですか？:
……You said you appeared from the gate

leading to the heavens. Is that true?
m920186.……あんな巨大な樹が、魔物に？\nそ、そんなの世界が\nぺっちゃんこにされちゃい:
...A tree that huge, turning into a monster?
T-That would just squash
the whole world flat, wouldn't it!?
m920186.……えっ？ し、師匠？\nなにを……あっ、いやっ、いやぁぁぁぁぁッ！？:
……Huh? M-Master?
What are you—Ah! No! Noooo!
m920186.……おそらく、このままでは遠くない未来に、\n世界樹そのものが巨大な魔物と化して:
...Most likely, if things continue as they are,
the World Tree itself will transform into a massive monster
in the near future.
m920186.……おっと、悪いな。\nただ今の状況が千年戦争のときより酷いってのに、\n何とか:
……Oh, my apologies.
It's just that the situation is far worse than during the Millennium War,
and the fact that I still feel we can pull through is… rather amusing.
m920186.……ぐっ、ぁあっ……！\n気をつけ、なさい……敵は天使だけではありません。\nこ:
……Ugh, aaah……!
Be careful…… the enemy is not just the angels.
These people…… they are driving the "Wedge of the Gods" into the World Tree……
m920186.……その必要はない。\nお前達はここで終わりだ。: …There's no need for that. This ends for you here.
m920186.……だが、邪魔が入らぬのは実に良い。\n元より王子達こそが、魔王様に反抗する最後:
……However, it is truly convenient that there are no interruptions.
The Prince and his party were always the last light
resisting the Demon Lord.
m920186.……な、なに思いつめた顔してるんですか！\n元から可能性の低い作戦だったんですよ:
……W-why are you looking so desperate!
It was a low-probability plan from the start!
m920186.……なるほど、堕天した者達には感じられませんか。\n世界樹に開いた天界へ続く門よ:
...I see, those who have fallen cannot feel it, can they?
The waves of power overflowing into this world,
through the gate to the heavens that has opened in the World Tree.
m920186.……なんとも、綱渡りな計画ですね。\n本当ならこんな、\n勝算の低すぎる作戦を選:
……What a razor-thin plan.
Ideally, we shouldn't be choosing a strategy
with such a slim chance of success…….
m920186.……はぁ。\nはいはい、また逃げるんですね。:
…Haa.
Yes, yes. Running away again, are we?
m920186.……ふふ、兵士長ぶりが板についてきましたね。\n避難民の警護は我々にお任せを。\: …Heh, you've really taken to being a sergeant now. Leave the refugee protection… to us. Prince, head to Lady Sybilla!
m920186.……ほう、我を討つか溺れる地上の民よ。\n良いだろう、初戦の勝利はそちらへ譲ろう: …Hmm, you who seek to slay me, drowning folk of the surface. Very well, I'll concede the first victory to you.
m920186.……ほう、王子の戯言ひとつで、\n立ち上がってみせるか、物質界の残滓共が。:
……Hmph. So a single word from the Prince is all it takes
for the remnants of the Material World to rise again.
m920186.……やめておけ、ゴブリン族が女王よ。\nそして行くが良い、溺れる者達よ。\n母な:
……Enough. You are the Queen of the Goblin race.

And you, go on. You who are drowning.

You who have forgotten the Mother Sea and chosen to live on the surface.
m920186.……やることは、山積みですね。\n急ぎ世界各地に兵を派遣しましょう。\n地上にど:
……We have a mountain of work to do.
We should dispatch troops to every corner of the world immediately.
We need to assess the damage on the surface.
m920186.……わ、悪いか。私がつけたんだ！\nでもこの戦いは、きっと後世まで残る英雄譚にな:
……I, I'm sorry. I named it!
But this battle will surely be remembered as a legendary tale for ages to come.
So it shouldn't be wrong, right?
m920186.……わかりました。\nですが、あなたも無理はしないでくださいね？:
……Understood.
But please, don't push yourself, either, all right?
m920186.……クラールフ殿。\nその答えは出たのですか。:
……Lord Kralhu.
Have you found the answer?
m920186.……グングニルで障壁を破り、\n二柱の女神の力を借りて、私が地脈を束ね、\nそれ:
……Break the barrier with Gungnir,
borrow the power of the two goddesses, have me gather the ley lines,
and pour it all into the warrior who will slay the Demon King…….
m920186.……メフィスト、甘いぞ。\n感じないのか、この禍々しい魔力を。:
……Mephisto, you're being naive.
Can't you feel it? This ominous surge of mana.
m920186.……大丈夫です。絶対に勝てます。\nこれまでだって、勝ってきたじゃないですか。:
……It's fine. We'll definitely win.
We've won before, haven't we?
m920186.……大天使長も『神の楔』のことを話していましたね。\n私の知る楔は、アイギス様や:
...The Archangel also mentioned the "God's Wedge."
From what I know, the Wedge is what Her Ladyship Aigis and Her Ladyship Adamas
used to perform miracles...
m920186.……強い精神支配の力を感じます。\nきっと異界召喚士が時間稼ぎのために……。:
……I sense a powerful mental domination.
The Dimensional Summoner is likely using it to buy time…
m920186.……後はお前達に任せよう。\n適当に遊んでやれ、いずれ死にゆく種族共だ。: …I'll leave the rest to you. Play as you like, you doomed races.
m920186.……恩に着ますわ、人間の娘よ。\nけれどわたくしよりも、この子を優先してください:
……I owe you, human girl.
But please tend to this child before you attend to me.
m920186.……惨めなものダ。\nソウカ……これが、敗北カ……。:
……A pathetic sight.
I see…… so this is what defeat feels like……
m920186.……星の声は、聞こえるようになった？: ……Can you hear the voice of the stars now?
m920186.……本当に、物質界は守られたんですね。: ……So the Material World really has been saved.
m920186.……然様。溺れる者は母なる海を忘れたが、\nそれと引き換えに多くの智慧を得た。\:
……Indeed. A drowning man forgets the mother sea,
but in exchange, he gains much wisdom.
Let none of us grow complacent.
m920186.……王国の、王子だ。\nただ仲間と共に、歩み続ける者だ。:
……I am the Prince of the kingdom.
Just someone who keeps walking forward, alongside my companions.
m920186.……王子、きっと世界中の皆さんが、\n王子の言葉を待っているはずです。:
……Prince, people all over the world
must be waiting for your words.
m920186.……王子、民を待たせ過ぎるのも考えものだぞ。: ……Prince, you shouldn't keep the people waiting any longer.
m920186.……王子、魔王ガリウスが来ます。\n必ず、勝機はあるはずです。\nどうか、どうか:
……Prince, Demon King Garius is coming.
There must be a chance for victory.
Please, good luck……!!
m920186.……王子は、必ず来てくれる。\nだからそれまで、膝をつくわけにはいかないの。: …The Prince will definitely come. So I can't just sit here waiting.
m920186.……知っているとも。だが！\n我輩がこの生の最後に望むのは王子との闘争。\n生き:
……I know. But!
What I desire in the final moments of my life is a battle with the Prince.
A fight that will burn away the proof of my existence!!
m920186.……神殺しの聖槍、か。\n無粋なものを持ち出すものだ……。:
……The God-Slaying Holy Lance, is it.
How tacky of you to bring that out……
m920186.……神無き地上に、天使に命を下すものはいない。\n大天使長、あんたに指示を出して:
……With no god on the ground, who is giving the angels their orders?
Archangel, who is the one commanding you?
m920186.……長く世界を蝕み続けた魔王という暗闇を、\n王子という輝きが、打ち払ったのです:
……The darkness of the Demon King, which has plagued the world for so long,
has been swept away by the radiance of the Prince.
m920186.……間違いない、門が開こうとしているぞ！\n異界召喚士の物に似ているが、\nより:
……I'm certain. The gate is opening!
It resembles the work of a Dimensional Summoner,
but I can read a far more precise formula…!
m920186.……魔王ガリウス、お前がもたらした悲劇の果てに、\n俺は幾度も、お前を倒すと誓い:
……Demon King Garius, at the end of the tragedy you brought,
I have sworn over and over again to defeat you.
m920186.……魔王軍幹部が勢揃いとは。\nどうやら本気で、\nここで決着をつけるつもりみた:
……The entire Demon Lord's executive is assembled.
It seems they are dead serious
about settling this here.
m920186.『はいっ、そ、それも予想外の所に！\n現在、帝国が魔王軍幹部の襲撃を受けています:
Yes—yes, that was unexpected!
The Empire is currently under attack by the Demon King's officers!
m920186.『北の大国より、魔王軍幹部が現れたと報告が！\n確認されたのはメカゴブリンクイー: “We've received reports that a Demon King army commander has appeared from the northern great nation! Confirmed are the Mech Goblin Queen and the force led by Gaoreon!”
m920186.『殿下？ 王子殿下！\nこのままでは魔王軍に\n『破滅の力』が奪われてしまいます:
“Your Highness? Prince!
At this rate, the Demon Army will seize the Power of Ruin…!”
m920186.『王子殿下！ 『破滅の力』の護衛にあたっている\n各地の部隊から、魔王の影の出現:
“Your Highness! Units guarding the Power of Ruin
in various locations are reporting the appearance of the Demon King's shadow!”
m920186.『眩く輝く、蒼空と、緑に満ちた世界を、\n俺が憧れたこの世界を、失うことは決して:
"I will never allow the loss of this world I have longed for,
where the blue sky shines brightly and the land is filled with green."
――That is all. You understand what it means, don't you?
m920186.『破滅の力』は無事だよ。\nでも、天守が隠し場所じゃないってバレちゃうのも、\n: The “Power of Ruin” is safe. But it's only a matter of time before they discover the keep isn't the hiding place…
m920186.『英雄王を継ぐ者』ですか……。\n確かに、王子にこそふさわしい称号だと思います。:
“The One Who Succeeds the Hero King”……
I truly believe that title fits the Prince perfectly.
m920186.『豪雨』の中では遠距離からの攻撃は狙いにくくなります。\n的確な指示をお願いしま: During the “Heavy Rain,” long-range attacks become hard to land. Please give precise orders!
m920186.あ、あなた方は！？\nどうしてこんな所まで……！:
Y-you……?
Why are you all here……!
m920186.あてこそがぁ！ 悪逆非道の魔王軍を誅すべく、\n姫侍と並び立つ、茨木童子――鬼刃: This is it! To punish the villainous Demon King, I, the Oni Blade Princess, stand beside the Princess Samurai—Iwaki Dōji!!
m920186.あなたは、異界召喚士の……。\n酷い……全身の魔力がぼろぼろじゃない……！:
You're a Dimensional Summoner…
How awful… Your magical energy is completely shattered…!
m920186.あなた達のせいです……。\n師匠が私に酷いことをしたのは、\nきっとあなた達のせ:
It's all your fault…
My master did terrible things to me,
and it must be because of you…
m920186.あなた達を倒せば……きっと師匠は、\n昔みたいに、一緒に実験をしてくれます……。:
If I defeat you… surely my master will
go back to how things were, and do experiments with me again…
m920186.あの時も、そうだった。\n魔物が復活し、王城を失ったあの日も。:
It was the same back then.
The day the monsters rose again and we lost the royal castle.
m920186.あらぁ……？\nでも白の皇帝ちゃんが見えないわね……。\nまさか尻尾を巻いて逃げ:
Oh my...?
But I don't see the White Emperor....
Did she perhaps turn tail and run?
m920186.あら？ レオナちゃんも\n嬉しくて泣きそうな顔をしていたのに、\nアンナちゃんの:
Oh? Leona, you looked like you were on the verge of tears with joy,
so I don't think you can say that about Anna.
m920186.あれは、以前にも見た独特な陣形ですね。\nいったい何を表しているのでしょうか……:
That is the same distinctive formation I saw before.
What could it possibly signify……?
m920186.あれは世界樹に埋め込まれた、\n神の力の欠片なるものによって、\n姿を変じた茨の:
It is a monster, which one might call the Queen of Thorns,
transformed by a fragment of divine power
embedded in the World Tree…….
m920186.あれは天馬……いえ、グリフィンですか！？: Is that a Pegasus……no, a Griffin!?
m920186.い、いえっ、それは駄目ですよー！！\n神を人間が宿す行為は、\nその人の死を意味:
N-no, you can't do that!!
A human housing a god
means that person's death, you know!?
m920186.いくつもの世界を引っ掻き回しただけでなく、\n自分の弟子にあんな酷いことをするな:
Not only have you wreaked havoc across countless worlds,
but you've done such a terrible thing to your own disciple.
m920186.いつまで軽口を叩いていられるかな。\n城壁内の魔物は駆逐中だ。\nそれから王子、: How long can you keep cracking jokes? The monsters inside the walls are being exterminated. And the Prince, the evacuation of the citizens is going smoothly!
m920186.いまさら鍵が一個無くなったからって何ですか！\nそう言って私に、皆に力を与えたの:
What does it matter if one key is missing now?
It was the Prince!
You're the one who gave me, and everyone else, the strength to fight!
m920186.うぅっ……ぐすっ……。\nやりました！ 魔王を倒しましたぁ！:
Ugh…… sniff…….
We did it! We defeated the Demon King!
m920186.うむ。これ以上は、どれだけ待ってもありえまい。\nシャディアよ、どうか友として、:
Yes. No amount of waiting will change this.
Shadia, as a friend,
please witness my final battle.
m920186.うむ。回り道ではあったがな。\n我らの故郷の仇を討ち、\nそして今は、望んでこの:
Yes. It was a roundabout journey.
We avenged our homeland,
and now, I have come to this place of my own will.
m920186.うむ。魔王軍が何するものぞ。\n増援が来ようとも、\n根こそぎ甲破りの錆としてく: Indeed. What can the Demon King army possibly do? Even if reinforcements arrive, we'll crush them down to rust.
m920186.えぇ、三女神の力が地上からほぼ失われた今、\n地上で活動できるのは、\n堕天した:
Indeed. Now that the power of the Three Goddesses has nearly vanished from the mortal realm,

the only beings capable of operating here

should be fallen ones like us.
m920186.えぇ、後世の吟遊詩人が喜ぶでしょうとも。\n何しろ英雄譚の登場人物本人が、\nそ:
Ah, the bards of the future will be delighted.
After all, the protagonist of the hero's legend
has graciously provided a fitting name.
m920186.えぇ。かつて一度は奪われたこの祖国、\nもう二度と奪わせはしません！\n――姫侍: Yes. This homeland once taken, we'll never let it be taken again! —Princess Samurai, Shizuka! We'll push forward!!
m920186.えぇ！ もちろんです！\n――あまねくこの星の全てよ、\n大地を紡ぐサナラの声に:
Yes! Of course!
――To all things upon this star,
answer the voice of Sanara who weaves the earth……!!
m920186.お、おおお、落ち着いてください！\nほら、深呼吸！ すーはー、すーはー。:
O-Oh, everyone, please stay calm!

Come on, take a deep breath. In and out, in and out.
m920186.おいおい、クレイブさん泣いてんのか？\n今は笑って喜ぶところだぜ！:
Hey, hey, are you crying, Crave?
Now's the time to laugh and celebrate!
m920186.おぉ……我輩の鎧が、砕けていく……。\nこれが……全てを焼き尽くし\n歩み続けて:
Oh…… my armor is shattering…….

Is this…… the end of me, who burned it all down

and kept walking on……?
m920186.おかげで世界の危機を救う足しになるだろう？\nおっと、それから、\nもうひとり王:
Well, it'll help save the world from crisis, right?
Oh, and by the way,
I brought a guard for someone else who wanted to meet the Prince.
m920186.おや、どうして嬉しそうなんですかアトナテス。\n地上が魔界になっちゃったんですよ:
Oh, why are you looking so happy, Atnates?
The surface has become the Demon Realm, you know?
m920186.お前は……そう、私に復讐をしにきたのね。\nでもそれは決して叶わない。\n王子諸:
You are……yes, you've come to seek revenge on me.
But that will never happen.
Prince and all, I'll put you down right here!
m920186.お前達ハ罠に掛かっタということダ。\n物質界最後ノ戦力たる王子タチよ。:
You have fallen into our trap.
You, the Prince and his party,
the last forces of the Material World.
m920186.か、神様だったんですか……！？\nって、あ、あれ……？ それなら……。:
H-his a god……!?
Wait, hold on…… If that's the case, then……
m920186.かつて王国の危機に私達が駆けつけたように、\n王子はこうして、私の国を助けにきて: Just as we rushed to aid the kingdom in its crisis before, the Prince has come to help my land.
m920186.がおがおちゃん、相変わらずですね……。\nでも真正面から足止めすれば、戦いに夢中: Gao-gao-chan, you're as usual… But if we block them head-on, they'll get so caught up in the fight they won't be able to use their ranged attacks!
m920186.くぅぅッ！！ やるではないかッ！！\n我を打ち破るとは、何たる蛮勇かッ！！: Kuu!! You've got some nerve!! To think you could break me—what sheer bravery!!
m920186.くっ……ぁあぁッ！！\nこのままでは、女神様達の力を維持できません……っ！:
Grrr…… Aaah!!
I can't maintain the Goddesses' power like this……!
m920186.ぐっ……レオナ、様……っ！\n伝令です……『破滅の力』が……っ！: Ugh… Leona, my lady…! It's a messenger… the “Power of Ruin”…!
m920186.けなげなものねぇ……。\n東の国へ向かった王子達が、\n助けに来てくれると信じて: How noble… Do the princes heading east really believe they'll come to our rescue?
m920186.けれど、迷っている暇はありません。\nたとえ成功が絶望的であったとしても、\n唯:
But we don't have the luxury of hesitation.
Even if success is hopeless,
if this is the only way left to save the material world.
m920186.こうなれば魔力を注ぎ込んで、\n新たな異界の門を……弟子よ！ どこにおる！？: If it comes to this, I'll pour in my mana and open a new gate to the Otherworld…… Disciple! Where are you!?
m920186.ここで撃墜されたら、空から乗り込む作戦が\n無駄になってしまいますからね。:
If we'd been shot down here, our plan to board from the sky
would have been for nothing.
m920186.ここは一度退かせてもらうわ。\nまた会いましょう王子、ウフフフッ！:
I'll withdraw for now.
Until we meet again, Prince—hehehe!
m920186.このまま瘴気濃度が上昇したら、\n物質界の人々は耐えきれないわねぇ。:
If the miasma levels keep climbing like this,
the people of the Material World won't be able to withstand it.
m920186.この世界の未来を、王子に託させてください。: Please entrust the future of this world to you.
m920186.この子は、天使の軍勢が出現した直後に、\n天界へ続く門より転がり出てきたのです。:
This child tumbled out of the gate to the heavens
the moment the angels appeared.
m920186.この感じ……そうか、魔界の亀裂を使って、\n別の場所へ移動していったのね。: This feeling… right, they used the demon-world fissure to move elsewhere.
m920186.この者らに、未だ忠義があるようであれば、\n我が足止めをしておこう。:
If any loyalty still remains in these creatures,

I shall hold them at bay.
m920186.この虫と同じ様に、\n世界樹と共に浄化してやりましょう。\nそれが愚かなる人の子:
Just like these insects,
we shall purify you along with the World Tree.
It is the least we can do for you foolish children of men.
m920186.この魔力の波動……くっ……！\n王子君、今の魔王に魔法は殆ど効きません！\nおび:
This magical fluctuation…… Grrr……!
Prince, magic barely works on the Demon King now!
He's continuously releasing an immense amount of mana!
m920186.こら、魔王様の御前ですよ。\nそれにこれより死にゆく者達にも、\n一定の敬意は払:
Watch your manners, we're in the presence of the Demon Lord.
Besides, one should show a certain amount of respect
to those who are about to die.
m920186.これが……これが人の力だと……？\nあの男ですら……予には届かなかったというのに:
This is…… this is the strength of a human……?
Not even that man…… could reach me…….
m920186.これくらいの傷、どうということはありません。\nまさか、私を倒せたとでも思いまし:
Scratches like these are nothing.
Did you really think you could defeat me?
m920186.これだけの魔界の瘴気だ、\n今までの物質界と同じだと考えるんじゃないぞ。\nこれ:
With this much miasma from the Demon Realm,
don't think it's the same as the Material World we knew.
We won't be able to use our full power like usual.
m920186.これまでだって、\n不可能に思えた作戦はいくつもありましたからね。\nそれでも勝:
We've faced plans that seemed impossible before, too.
Yet we kept finding a way to win. That's why we're here.
m920186.こんな貴重なものを……って、\n癒しの至宝まで入ってるです。\nこっそりくすねて:
Such precious items…… wait,
there's even a Treasure of Healing in there.
Were you sneaking around to steal them?
m920186.さぁ、王国へ帰還しましょう！！: Come on, let's return to the kingdom!!
m920186.さぁて、それはどうかしらぁ？\n人はどこまでも強欲なものよ。\n滅びを前にして、:
Oh, is that so?
Humans are endlessly greedy.
Can they really accept defeat in the face of destruction?
m920186.さぁ弟子よ、お前はこの時の為に育ててきたのじゃ。\nその有り余る魔力の泉を、\n:
Now then, my apprentice. I raised you for this very moment.
Surrender your overflowing spring of mana to me,
and become the cornerstone for the Demon King…!!
m920186.しかし、各地の戦闘の爪痕の修復には、\nまだまだ時間がかかりそうですね……。:
However, repairing the scars of battle across the land

will still take quite some time……
m920186.しかし、少々癪に障るのも確か。\n私の本来の力を見せてあげましょうか……。:
However, it is certainly irritating.
Shall I show you my true power…?
m920186.しかし世界樹に埋め込んだ『神の楔』は、\nいまやその幹の深くにまで至っています。:
However, the "Wedge of the Gods" embedded in the World Tree
has now reached deep into its trunk.
We can say our objective has been sufficiently achieved.
m920186.しかし所詮は浅知恵よ。\n少々手間ではあるが、この地の全てを蹂躙すれば、\n自ず: But it's just a shallow trick. It may take some effort, but if we lay waste to this entire land, the hiding place will inevitably be revealed.
m920186.しみったれた顔してんじゃねぇよ。\nおら、派手に凱旋して勝利を伝えてやろうぜ！:
Stop making such a pitiful face.
Come on, let's throw a grand victory parade and announce our triumph!
m920186.す、すみません王子っ！\n軍議中だからだめですよって止めたんですけど……。:
P-Prince, please!
I tried to stop her, but she wouldn't listen during a war council……
m920186.そう……か……。\n王子よ……もう二度と逢うことはないだろうが、\nお前のことは:
I see…….
Prince…… we will never meet again,
but I shall never…… forget you…….
m920186.そうか……我は、とうとう負けたのだな……。: I see…… so I have finally met my defeat……
m920186.そうそう、その顔です！\n白の皇帝は必ず来ます。\nそれまでに、私達ができること:
That's it, that's the face I wanted to see!
The White Emperor is coming.
Until then, let's do what we can!
m920186.そうだな。\n昔からずっと、やることは変わらない。\n王子が戦うって言うんだから:
That's right.
We've always done the same thing.
If the Prince says he's going to fight, we have to support him.
m920186.そうだね～♪\nよわよわ人間の邪魔したし、遊んであげたし、\n魔王様に報告しに帰:
That's right~♪
We've bothered the weak humans and had our fun,
so let's go report back to the Demon Lord~♪
m920186.そうよ、世界中で戦っていた仲間に、\nちゃんと勝ったぞって報告しなくちゃ！: That's right. We need to report to our comrades fighting all over the world that we've won.
m920186.そこで、神を滅ぼすための手段が必要になるのです。\nそもそも、魔王ガリウスはかつ:
Which is why we need a means to slay a god.
After all, the Demon King Garius was once
one of the gods, on par with Aigis.
m920186.そしてヘイオス、ミーティア、シャディアよ。\n我輩の勝手に付き合わせて、済まなか:
And Heios, Meteor, Shadia.
I'm sorry for dragging you into this mess.
m920186.そちらもね。\nさぁ、わたくしの子供たち、\nエルフ達に協力し、世界樹の火を消し:
And you, young lady.
Now then, my children,
work with the elves to put out the fires on the World Tree.
m920186.その意気や良しッ！！\n流石は王国に並び立つ、北の大国の姫君よッ！！: That's the spirit!! As befits a princess of the great northern nation that stands beside the kingdom!!
m920186.それだけじゃないですよ！\n奪い合ってるってことは、\n一個や二個じゃないってこ:
It's not just that!
If they're fighting over them,
that means there's more than one or two, right?
m920186.それで、英雄王さん？ の仲間だったという方に\n助けてもらいながら、\nこうして:
So, with the help of someone who was said to be a companion of the Hero King,
we managed to escape here to the Material World.
m920186.それでこそ王子よ。\n民に危機が迫ったとなれば、\n己を顧みずに駆け出してしまう:
Now that is the Prince.
When the people are in danger,
he rushes to their aid without a second thought for himself♪
m920186.それでは王子、北の大国へ向かいましょう。\nシビラさん達が待っているはずです！: Then, Prince, let's head to the northern great nation. Shibira and the others should be waiting!
m920186.それなら、かかっていらっしゃい。\nどこまでも栄光と勝利に強欲ながおがおちゃん！:
Then come at me.
You, the greedy champion who craves glory and victory!
m920186.それは由々しき事態ですね……。\n本当は共存の道を探りたいところですが、\n襲撃:
That is a grave situation…….
We would prefer to seek a path to coexistence,
but we must stop these attacks immediately!
m920186.それを打ち破らなければ、\n『破滅の力』を止めることも、\nガリウスを滅ぼすこと:
If we can't break through that,
we won't be able to stop the "Power of Ruin,"
let alone destroy Garius……
m920186.そんな……。\n何か、何か打つ手は……。:
No……
Is there…… is there anything else we can do……?
m920186.そんなことは、絶対にさせません。\n私達はここへ、死ぬために来たのではなく、\n:
We will absolutely not allow that.
We did not come here to die,
but to save the world.
m920186.ただ、ここ最近はお姿を見せなくなってしまって、\nずっと心配していたんですが……:
It's just that she hasn't shown her face lately,

and I've been worried about her…….
m920186.だ、だめですっ！ ここは空の上ですよ！？\nそっちに行ったら飛空船から落ちて――:
N-No! We're up in the air!
If you go over there, you'll fall off the airship――
m920186.だぁぁぁああぁぁぁッ！！\nポーションがもう無いぞ！\n飲み尽くしちまったぞ！！:
Daahhhhh!!
We're out of potions!
I drank them all!!
m920186.だから飛空船をかっ飛ばしてるんだろ？\n目的地の城は目前だ。機関は悲鳴を上げてる:
That's why we're flying this airship at top speed, right?
The destination castle is right in front of us. The engines are screaming,
but they'll hold on for just a little longer.
m920186.だが、ここで幹部をふたり同時に抑えれば、\n他の連中が守る地に向かう敵が減るって: But if we take down both commanders now, fewer enemies will head toward the lands our allies are defending. Prince, let's give them a crushing blow!
m920186.だが、たかが大地の気の流れに、\n女神どもの力を注いだとて、\n予に傷ひとつ付け:
But even if you pour the power of those goddesses
into the mere flow of the earth's energy,
you won't be able to scratch me.
m920186.だが、アダマス様はようやく復活したばかり、\nアイギス様は、実体を得ることすらま:
But Adamas has only just regained his form,
and Aigis cannot even manifest a physical body.
They are in no state to lend us their power.
m920186.だが、限られた戦力でいつまで、\n魔界の軍勢に抗うことができるのか……。\n此度: But with limited forces, how long can you resist the demonic army…? I'm looking forward to how this millennium war ends.
m920186.だが、障壁を突破しても、\n『破滅の力』を手にしたガリウスを、\n倒せる者はいる:
But even if we breach the barrier,
is there anyone who can defeat Garius,
now that he wields the "Power of Ruin"……?
m920186.だが、魔王軍の目がこちらへ向いたのは僥倖だ。\n聖槍の回収へ向かった白の帝国を、:
However, it's fortunate that the Demon Army's attention is now on us.
We cannot afford to be discovered
while the White Empire is recovering the Holy Lance.
m920186.ちぃっ、もう弓も届かないところに……！: Tch, it's already out of bow range……!
m920186.てめぇ、知ってやがったな……？\n俺達を嘲笑うために見過ごしてたってのか。:
You knew, didn't you……?
You let it happen just to mock us.
m920186.ですから、私にも戦わせてください。\n剣も魔法も使えませんが、\n私にしか出来な:
So, please let me fight alongside you.
I can't wield a sword or magic,
but I can fight in a way only I can.
m920186.ですが、あなた達ならば、\nきっとその手で未来を切り拓いて行けるはずです。:
But you, with your own hands,
will surely carve out a future for yourselves.
m920186.ですが、本来の力を取り戻した魔王ガリウスは、\nかつて戦った折にも強力な障壁を纏:
However, the Demon King Garius, having regained his full power,
was wrapped in an impenetrable barrier even when we fought him before.
m920186.ですが、私達は何があっても、\n絶対に王子に付いていきますからね……！: But no matter what happens, we'll stand by you to the end…!
m920186.では何故、私達と相対しているのですか。: Then why are you facing us?
m920186.でも、あくまで生き延びただけです。\nこの瘴気の濃度、完全に魔界そのものですね…:
But we've only managed to survive.
The density of this miasma… it's practically the Demon Realm itself…….
m920186.でも、もう時間切れじゃないかしら。\nさぁ『破滅の力』の隠し場所、\nそろそろ教: But isn't the time running out? Now, tell me where the hidden “Power of Ruin” is.
m920186.でもちょっとだけムカっとしたから、\nすこーしだけ本気出しちゃおうかなぁ？:
But I got a little annoyed, so
maybe I'll try a little harder?
m920186.ところで知っていますか？\n城下では王子のことを\n英雄王の再来だって噂している:
By the way, did you know?
In the town below the castle, people are whispering
that the Prince is the Hero King reborn.
m920186.となれば、何としてでもこの戦いを、\n後の世に伝えられるように、\n僕らは勝利し:
In that case, no matter what it takes,
we must win this battle
so that it can be passed down to future generations.
m920186.とはいえ、こちらにも\n追撃するだけの余力はありません。\n何しろ飛空船による遊: That said, we don't have the strength to pursue them. After all, they're a hit-and-run unit on an airship.
m920186.とはいえ、神殿が瘴気に沈むのも時間の問題でしょう。\n私達に残された時間は、限り:
Even so, it's only a matter of time before the temples are swallowed by the miasma.
The time we have left is extremely limited…
m920186.とはいえ、陰陽と呪術を束ねても、\n『破滅の力』の波動を隠し続けるのは難しいでし: Still, even binding yin-yang and sorcery, concealing the wave of the “Power of Ruin” will be hard. Have we contacted the Prince's strike force…?
m920186.とはいえ『破滅の力』は七つ揃って、\n初めてその効果を発揮するのだろう？\nなら:
Still, the Power of Ruin only awakens its true potential
once all seven fragments are united, correct?
If we had guarded the other locations—
m920186.ともあれ、見過ごすことは出来ません。\n王子、戦闘の準備をお願いします！:
In any case, we can't ignore it.
Prince, please prepare for battle!
m920186.ともかく、今は消火と負傷者の救助が最優先です。\n女王蜘蛛もっ！ 大人しく治療さ:
For now, putting out the fire and rescuing the injured is the top priority.
Queen Spider, too! Please let yourself be treated!
m920186.ともかく、飛空船に被害がなくて何よりですね。\n魔王城に乗り込む前に\n撃墜され:
In any case, I'm glad the airship hasn't been damaged.
It would have been a disaster if we'd been shot down
before we could board the Demon Lord's Castle…
m920186.どういうことだ。\n一体何を言って――:
What are you talking about?
What do you mean――
m920186.どうしたソラス、早くその槍を王子に渡せ！: What's wrong, Solais? Hand that spear to the Prince quickly!
m920186.なぁに、街も建物も、\n職人総出ですぐに直してやるよ！:
Don't worry, the towns and buildings,

our craftsmen will have them fixed right up!
m920186.ないわけではありません。\nつまりは魔界化の根源、\n『破滅の力』による瘴気の拡:
It's not impossible.
Essentially, we just need to stop the spread of miasma caused by the root of Demonization,
the "Power of Ruin."
m920186.なっ……どうして王子達がここにいるのよ！？\n東の国へ向かったのではないの！？: Wha… why are the princes here?! Weren't they supposed to head east?!
m920186.ならば、ここでその火を消すことが、\n魔王様が道行を正しく果たすための、\n最大:
Then extinguishing that flame here
will be the greatest feat
in ensuring the Demon Lord fulfills his path correctly!
m920186.ならば、やってみせるが良い。\n門を開け、異界召喚士。:
Then show me what you've got.
Open the gate, Otherworld Summoner.
m920186.なるほど、帝国の飛空船を使ったなッ！\nだがこれも好機、我が闘志を\n振り下ろす: I see, you used the empire's airships! But that's also an opportunity—I've been waiting for a chance to unleash my fighting spirit!
m920186.なるほど、聖槍グングニル……！\n確かにそれなら、障壁の突破も可能ですね。:
I see, the Holy Spear Gungnir……!
Indeed, if that's the case, breaking the barrier is possible.
m920186.なれば、お前達をここに釘付けにすれば、\n後は有象無象が蔓延るのみ……。:
Therefore, if I pin you down here,
the rest will be left to the common rabble.
m920186.は、はぁ、とても面倒見の良い方で、\n私の作る料理をいつも、\n美味しい美味しい:
Y-Yes, she was a very caring person.

She always ate the meals I made

and said they were delicious.
m920186.は、はい……。\nうぅぅ、どうして、どうしてこんなことに……。: Y-yes… *sniff* How did it come to this…?
m920186.は、はいっ、あの場所が\n天界だったのかどうかは分かりませんが、\nケラウノス様:
Y-Yes! I don't know if that place

was actually the heavens,

but I definitely served Lady Keranos!
m920186.はぁ……はぁ……ま、間に合いました……。: Haa… haa… We made it in time…
m920186.はぁ～い♪\nよわよわな王子ちゃん達とぉ、遊んであげまぁーす♪:
Yaaay♪
I'll have some fun with the weak, wimpy Prince and his friends♪
m920186.はい、魔界の門が閉じて帰れなくなった魔物が、\nあちこちの村を襲っているのだとか:
Yes. Monsters that couldn't return home after the Gate to the Demon World closed
are raiding villages all over the place.
m920186.はて、何のことだろうか……。\nさぁ、世界の担い手たるは何れか、\nその実力をも:
Hm, what do you mean……?
Very well, you who bear the weight of this world.
Prove your worth with your strength!
m920186.ははぁっ！\nほれ、魔力を寄越せ不肖の弟子よ。:
Hahaa!
Come, give me your magic power, you useless apprentice!
m920186.ひゃ、ひゃいっ！\nすーひゃー……すーひゃー……。:
Y-Yes, sir!

In and out…… in and out…….
m920186.ふふ、それは問題ないかと。\nケラウノスを宿した折にも、\n私の身体は無事だった:
Heh, that won't be a problem.
When I housed Keranos,
my body remained unharmed.
m920186.ふふっ、さぁ、いってらっしゃい。\nここは私達に任せてね。:
Hehe, off you go.
We'll take it from here.
m920186.ふふっ、皆さん、\n王子の勝利宣言を待っているんですよ。:
Hehe, everyone,
we're waiting for the Prince's declaration of victory.
m920186.ふふっ、頼りにしていますね。\n――ドロテアさん、魔界の様子は如何ですか？:
Hehe, we're counting on you.

――Dorothea, how is the situation in the Demon Realm?
m920186.ほう……地脈を束ねるその術、見覚えがある。\nあの時、あの男と共に予に抗った者の:
Hm…… That art of binding the ley lines. I recognize it.
You must be one of those who defied me alongside that man back then.
m920186.まさかこれ程の抵抗を見せてくるとは……ッ！！\nこのマッチの勝利は、お前に譲ると: I never imagined you'd put up such resistance…!! I'll concede this match to you!! It's been a fine battle! Hahaha!!
m920186.まさか初めから、\n別の場所に隠していたというのか！？: So they hid it somewhere else from the start!?
m920186.まずは一勝か。\nだがあいつらを逃す手はないぞ王子。\n結局最後には激突するんだ: First, we need a win. But we can't let them get away, Prince. In the end we'll clash here—
m920186.まだだ……まだ戦えるぞ！\n我輩の鎧は砕けず、剣も折れてはいないっ！！: Not yet... I can still fight! My armor hasn't shattered, and my sword hasn't broken!!
m920186.まだよ……まだ……私は……。: Not yet…… not yet…… I am……
m920186.むぅぅ、何だか分かったような顔してるのズルいです！\n私にも今まで起きたことを教:
Muuu, it's so unfair that you look like you understand everything!
Tell me what has happened up to now, please!
m920186.もしかしたら、何か天界のことを\n知っているかもしれませんわ。:
Perhaps she knows something
about what lies in the heavens.
m920186.もしや……世界樹の内側から……？: Could it be... from inside the World Tree...?
m920186.もっちろん！\n行くよゴライア、勝利を盗んであげるから！:
Of course!
Let's go, Goliah. I'll steal victory for us!
m920186.や、やめろっ！ その子が死んでしまうっ！: S-Stop it! That child will die!
m920186.やってみせるがいい！ 矮小なる人の子よ！\nその手がここまで届くのか、\n全存在:
Show me! You insignificant child of man!
Can your hand reach this far?
Bet everything you have and come at me……!!
m920186.やっと……やっと終わったんですね。\n魔王との戦いが、ようやく……！:
It's finally…… finally over.
The war with the Demon King is finally……!
m920186.やれやれ、いまさら実感したのか？\n王国の政務官には困ったものだな。:
I see, you're only feeling it now?
You have me worried, you Royal Administrator.
m920186.ようやく、終わったんだな……。\nさぁ王子、皆に言うことがあるんじゃないか？:
It's finally over…….
Well, Prince, isn't there something you want to tell everyone?
m920186.よかろう、予の真なる姿を見ることを許す！\nお前達の力の全て、出し尽くしてみせよ:
Very well. I grant you the sight of my true form!
Unleash every ounce of your power!!
m920186.わ、わわわっ！？\nあの速度じゃ止まれないよ！\n王子、受け止めてあげてー！！:
W-what!?
At that speed we can't stop!
Prince, catch it—!
m920186.わざわざ我らがそれを教えるとでも？\n我らはただ、命に従い浄化を執行するのみ。:
Do you really think we would tell you?
We merely follow orders and carry out the purification.
m920186.わたくしよりも、今は天使を……！\nこのままでは……ぁっ、ぐっ、\n世界樹が……:
The angels are more important than me, right now……!
If we don't do something…… aah, ugh,
the World Tree…… it's going to burn down……!
m920186.アイギス様もアダマス様もケラウノス様も、\nほぼ全ての力を使い果たしているはず…:
Aigis, Adamas, and Keranos

should have expended nearly all of their power…….

This is clearly an abnormal situation.
m920186.アンナお姉様の言うとおりです。\n今は魔物の軍勢を蹴散らして、\nこの場を切り抜:
Just as Anna-nee says.
Right now, we need to smash through the monster army
and get out of here.
m920186.ウオオオオォォッ！！\n喰らいやがレ！ クロコォ！！:
UOOOOOORRRR!!
Take that, you bastard! Croco!!
m920186.ウフフッ、この戦力を見て、\nまだそんな口が利けるのかしら？\n蛮勇を超えて、も:
Uh-huh. Looking at our strength,
can you still say such things?
That is not just recklessness; it is sheer stupidity.
m920186.ウフフッ、やはり王子率いる軍勢は、\n一筋縄ではいかないわねぇ……っ！！: Heh heh, as expected, the army led by the Prince isn't something you can handle with a single trick…!!
m920186.ウルセェ！ テメェと会話スルつもりはねェんだよ！\n今日は決着ヲつけに来たんだか:
Shut up! I have no intention of talking to you!
I came here today to settle this once and for all!!
m920186.キ、キヒィッ！？\n何故だ！？ なぜこれ程の力をぉ！？:
K-Kiiih!?!
Why!? Why do you have such power!?
m920186.キヒィッ！？\nワシは逃げるぞ！ 弟子っ、付いてこい！！:
Kihii?!
I'm getting out of here! Apprentice, follow me!!
m920186.キヒィーッ！\n魔王様のお力の欠片をお借りしますぞ！\nいでよ、御姿の映し身よぉ: Kihii! I'll borrow a fragment of the Demon King's power! Come forth, reflected image of his form…!!
m920186.キヒィー！！ それがどうした！？\n所詮は小規模な遊撃部隊。\nクロコよ、ここで: Kihii!! So what? It's just a small skirmish force. Croco, crush them here!!
m920186.キヒィ！ 所詮は悪あがき、\n行くぞ物質界最後の抵抗勢力どもよ！:
Kihi! It's just a last-ditch effort.
Come on, you remnants of the Material World's resistance!
m920186.キヒィ！ 魔力量だけがお前の取り柄じゃからな！\n存分に絞り尽くし、同時召喚の贄:
Kihii! Your mana is your only virtue!
I'll wring every last drop from you
and make you the sacrifice for a simultaneous summoning!
m920186.キヒッ？ 何を言っている？\n増援を待っているなら見当違いだ。: Kihi? What are you saying? If you're waiting for reinforcements, you're off-target.
m920186.キヒヒッ！ 尻尾を巻いて逃げれば良いものを、\nそんな小娘を守って死ぬ気とは！: Kihihi! You could've just fled with your tail between your legs, yet you die protecting that little girl!
m920186.ギャギャ！ 常闇ノ聖霊モ！\nチカラ！ カシテクレタ！:
Gyagya! The Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness!
Gave us! Power!
m920186.クラールフ、デシウス、撤退していきます。\n王子、この地の『破滅の力』は守られま: Kralhu, Decius, we're withdrawing. Prince, the “Power of Ruin” here has been secured.
m920186.グッ……！？\n私に傷を負わせるトハ……。\n良いだロウ、この勝負はお前タチに譲:
Grrr…?!
To wound me…
Very well. I'll concede this match to you…
m920186.ケッ、出直しテきやがれ！\nテメェらの戯言に付き合ってル暇はねェんだよ！:
Tch, get back on your feet and try again!

I don't have time to keep entertaining your little games!
m920186.ケッ、竜人族ノ恥晒しが良く吠えるゼ！: Tch, look at the disgrace of the Dragonkin barking like that!
m920186.ケラウノスを倒した聖槍グングニル……。\nあの槍に、神を滅ぼす力は殆ど残っていま:
The Holy Spear Gungnir, which felled Keranos……
Though it retains little of the power to kill gods,
it should still be able to shatter a barrier, right……?
m920186.ケラウノス様以外の方と\nお話することはあまりなかったのですが、\nある方が、こ:
I didn't have much opportunity to speak with anyone

other than Lady Keranos,

but one person told me this.
m920186.コホン。王子殿下、世界樹より伝令です。\n世界樹に天使の軍勢が出現しました！！:
*Cough*. Your Highness, a message from the World Tree.

An army of angels has appeared at the World Tree!!
m920186.サナラさん、始めましょう。\n私達に出来ることを、私達にしかできないことを。:
Sanara, let's begin.
Let's do what we can, what only we can do.
m920186.シャディアちゃん、私の力で地脈を束ね、\n一人の戦士に大地の力を注ぎ込んだらどう:
Shady-chan, what if I gathered the ley lines
and channeled the power of the earth into a single warrior?
m920186.シャディアよ、ゆめゆめ忘れるなかれ。\nこれはこやつらに恥を重ねさせぬためだ。\:
Shadia, never forget.

This is not to spare them from further shame.

I am not siding with those who are drowning.
m920186.ソラスさん、サナラさん、\n何か打つ手はないのでしょうか……？:
Solais, Sanara,
is there anything we can do…?
m920186.デシウス、望んだ道は貫けましたか？: Decius, did you manage to walk the path you wished for?
m920186.トドメを刺されるのは、あなたの方。\nわたしはもう、絶対に負けない。\nわたしに:
The one who gets put down is you.
I will absolutely not lose.
Because I have the Prince.
m920186.ドルイドの皆さんに世界樹に埋め込まれた、\n『神の楔』を調査してもらったのですが:
We had the druids investigate the "God's Wedge"
embedded in the World Tree, but...
m920186.ドワーフ族が復興に協力してるんだから、\nあっという間に元通りに決まってるでしょ:
The Dwarves are helping with the reconstruction,

so it'll be back to normal in no time, right?
m920186.ヌゥ、それが皆目聞こえぬままだ。\n師には顔向けできぬなぁ。:
No, not at all.
I won't be able to show my face to my master.
m920186.ヌゥゥッ！！\n王子よ、死ぬなよ！ 絶対に死ぬな！！\n生きて我輩との闘争に決着: Nuu!! Prince, don't die! Absolutely don't die!! Stay alive and finish this fight with me!!
m920186.ハハハハハハハハッ！！\nそうか！ 予に匹敵するか！！:
Hahahaha!!
So! You are a match for me!
m920186.フハハハッ！ とうとうこの時が来たッ！\nこの世界のファイナルマッチであるッ！:
Fuhahaha! The time has finally come!
The final match of this world!
m920186.フハハハッ！！ 良いぞ、心が躍るッ！！\nだが、覇者たる我を差し置いて、\nファ: Fuhahaha!! Excellent, my heart leaps!! But setting aside the conqueror that I am, the final match won't begin!!
m920186.フローガさん、大丈夫です、聞こえています。\nまた魔王軍が現れましたか？:
Floga-san, we're fine, we can hear you.
Did the Demon King's army appear again?
m920186.フローガよ……。\n手遅れやもしれぬぞ……。\n王子、今この場に近付いてくる魔力:
Floga…
It may already be too late…
Prince, the wave of mana approaching this area is—
m920186.ホウ、国民に矛先が向かヌよう、\n皇帝自ら私達を引きつけていたというノカ……。: So, to keep the populace from turning against us, the Emperor himself drew us in, huh…
m920186.リングに上がらぬ者に勝利はないッ！\nだがあの猛者が逃げるとも思えぬ、\nおそら:
There is no victory for those who refuse to enter the ring!
But I doubt that fierce warrior would flee.
She is likely devising some scheme!
m920186.不要な枝葉は全て焼け落ち、\n力ある幹は神の力の欠片によって魔物と化す。\n世界:
The unnecessary branches and leaves will all burn away,
and the powerful trunk will be transformed into a monster
by a fragment of divine power.
The World Tree is destined to perish just like this.
m920186.世界が、ほろんじゃう、なんて……。\nぐすっ……やだ……いやです、そんなの……。:
The world is going to crumble…
Sniff… no… I don't want that… I don't…
m920186.世界樹すら魔物にしてしまう力を宿した、\n『神の楔』を奪い合う戦いが、天界で……:
A war in the heavens, fighting over the "God's Wedge,"
which holds the power to turn even the World Tree into a monster...
m920186.世界樹の災厄、天界へ続く門、天使の軍勢。\n王子、どうやらまだ、戦いは終わらない:
The calamity of the World Tree, the gate to the heavens, the angelic host.
Prince, it seems the war is far from over.
m920186.世界樹を滅ぼさせるわけにはいきません。\n王子、急ぎ迎撃の準備をお願いします！:
We can't let the World Tree be destroyed.
Prince, hurry and prepare the interception!
m920186.人々を導き、勇気づけ、\n不可能に見えたことを可能にしていく。\n確かにあいつは:
Guiding the people, inspiring them,
turning the impossible into the possible.
He truly is of the Hero King's lineage, I suppose.
m920186.人の子をかばったばかりに……。\nくっ……不覚ですわね……。:
I shielded the children of men, and now…….
Tch…… how careless of me…….
m920186.人の性質は……そう簡単に変わりはせぬもの。\n王子がここへ来ることも……また必定:
A person's nature……does not change so easily.
It was inevitable that the Prince would come here.
m920186.人の身で、神にして魔王たる予の力に、\nどこまで付いてこられるか、抗ってみせろ。:
Can you keep up with the power of one who is both god and Demon King in human form?
Try to resist.
m920186.人間もなァ、悪いヤツばかりじゃねェ。\n物質界だってそういうもんダ。\n行くぞベ:
Humans aren't all bad, you know.
The Material Realm is the same way.
Let's go, Berna. Let's teach this fool a lesson!
m920186.今はとにかく多くの意見が\n欲しいところですから大丈夫ですよ。\n――ところで、:
Right now, we need as many opinions as possible, so it's fine.
—By the way, what does it mean to become a goddess's vessel……?
m920186.今はまだ、魔界の入り口程度の瘴気ですが、\nこのまま侵食が進めば、\n地上の人々:
Right now, it's barely the entrance to the Demon Realm,
but if this erosion continues,
the people of the surface will all weaken, and eventually…….
m920186.今度は封印なんて半端なものじゃない。\n真の滅びってやつだ、魂まで砕けちまえ！:
This time it's not some half-baked seal.
It's true annihilation! Shatter to your very souls!
m920186.以前ケラウノスを倒した時には、\n聖槍の力をほぼ使い果たす程の力が必要だった。\:
When we defeated Keranos before,
it took nearly all the spear's power to do so.
Where could we possibly find that much strength……?
m920186.伝承に謳われし英傑……。\n星を詠む者と、大地を紡ぐ者……。\nそうか、天地の両:
The heroes sung of in legend…….
The one who sings of the stars, and the one who weaves the earth…….
I see, you erected barriers from both the heavens and the ground.
m920186.何、あれ……？\nあんな魔物見たことないよ……？:
What is that……?
I've never seen a monster like that before……?
m920186.俺は、絶対に諦めない。\n皆の力を、俺に貸してくれ。:
I will never give up.
Lend me your strength, all of you.
m920186.偶然上手くいっただけ、ですけどね。\nもう一度狙ってやれって言われても無理でしょ:
It was just a lucky fluke.
If he tries that again, I don't think we could pull it off…….
m920186.元より、『破滅の力』を分散させたのは、\nこうして時間を稼ぐためだものね。\nこ: From the start we dispersed the “Power of Ruin” to buy time. Let's keep the source hidden and continue the defense.
m920186.兵の士気にも影響が出ることでしょう。\nけれど、神々の神器ならば、\nこの瘴気か:
It will likely affect the soldiers' morale as well.
However, if we use the gods' divine artifacts,
we might be able to shield the troops from the miasma.
m920186.勝算が低いってもんじゃないぜ。\n仮定に仮定を重ねた、机上の空論の塊だ。:
It's not just about the odds.
It's a pile of hypotheticals stacked on top of hypotheticals. Pure armchair theory.
m920186.勝算の低い作戦だったのに、\n皆さんと一緒にいると、\n不思議と上手くいくような:
It was a plan with low odds of success,
but being with everyone,
I have a strange feeling that things will work out.
m920186.卑怯なる遠距離の凶器は我が引きつけてやろうッ！\n鍛え抜かれし肉体にて、\n百獣:
Cowardly ranged weapons, I'll draw you in!
With my honed body, challenge the champion of the hundred beasts—me!!
m920186.地上に取り残された魔物も多いが、\nこれまでのように\n頻繁に都市が襲撃されるこ:
Many demons remain stranded on the surface,

but cities will no longer be attacked

as frequently as before.
m920186.城内に、魔王ガリウスが出現……っ！\n護衛部隊の被害甚大、『破滅の力』も\nガリ: In the castle, Demon Garius has appeared…! The escort unit suffered heavy losses, and the “Power of Ruin” fell into Garius's hands…!
m920186.報告は正確にしろ。\n『破滅の力』がどうしたと言うんだ。: Report accurately. What about this “Power of Ruin”?
m920186.大丈夫、シズカの想定通りだよ。\nそのまま天守に『破滅の力』があるように思わせて: It's fine, just as Shizuka expected. Let them think the “Power of Ruin” is in the keep, and fight while minimizing damage.
m920186.大丈夫よぉ、ミコトちゃん。\nほぉら、今ちょうど、\n王子達が駆けつけてくれたわ: Don't worry, Mikoto-chan. Look, the princes have just arrived.
m920186.大口を叩けるのもここまでじゃ！\n異界より来たれ、我が配下よ……っ！！:
Your big talk ends here!
Come forth from the Otherworld, my subordinates……!!
m920186.大天使長、もはや地上に、\n天使に命をくだす神は存在しません。\n何故、こんなこ:
Archangel, there is no god left on the ground
to command the angels.
Why are you doing this?
m920186.天使の軍勢……？\n待って、そんなの、絶対ありえない。:
An army of angels……?

Wait, that's absolutely impossible.
m920186.天使は本来、神の命令なくして活動することはないのです。\n今この地上に、\n神の:
Angels are not supposed to act without the direct command of a god.

There should be no one on this earth

who possesses divine power…….
m920186.天界へ続く、門……？: A gate leading to the heavens...?
m920186.天馬騎士団、及び帝国所属の飛空船にて、\n地上の様相を観測しましたが――: We observed the state of the ground from the Pegasus Knights' and the Empire's airships, but—
m920186.女王蜘蛛……！\nなんて酷い……今助けますからね！:
Queen Spider……!
How terrible…… I'll help you now!
m920186.如何に強力なデーモンであろうと、\n無傷ということはないだろう。:
No matter how powerful a demon may be,
they cannot remain unscathed.
m920186.定命の者よ、物質界に蔓延る人の王子よ。\nお前の願いは、決して届くことはない。:
Mortal, son of man who spreads through the Material World.
Your wish will never be granted.
m920186.師匠から教わった異界召喚で、\nあなた達を……ここで倒します……。\nぜんぶ、全:
I'll use the Dimensional Summoning I learned from my master
to defeat you… right here…
Everything is your fault… all of it…!!
m920186.平たく言えば、ガリウスを倒せ、ということですか……。: In plain terms, does that mean we have to defeat Garius…?
m920186.後はお前の仕事だ、王子。\n聖槍を振るうのも、\n世界を救うのも、俺には荷が重す:
The rest is your job, Prince.
Wielding the holy spear,
saving the world…… it's too heavy a burden for me.
m920186.思い上がった人の子らよ、\nここでお前達の歴史を終わらせてやろう。:
You overconfident children of man.
I shall end your history right here.
m920186.情報共有は拠点に戻ってからにしましょう。\nまずは世界に起きた異変の調査をしなけ:
We'll share information after we get back to base.
First, we need to investigate the anomalies affecting the world.
m920186.愚かナ。ダガ、その武人としてのあり方、\n私の記憶ニ刻んでオコウ。: Foolish. Dag, remember your warrior's way and carve it into my memory.
m920186.我々も協力しよう。\n瘴気の中でも飛空船は機能するはずだ。:
We will lend our aid.
The airship should still function even in the miasma.
m920186.我が臣下共よ『破滅の力』を掲げよ。\nこれより物質界は消滅し、\n全てが魔界によ:
My subjects, raise the Power of Ruin.
From this moment, the material world shall cease to exist,
and all shall be overwritten by the Demon Realm.
m920186.持ってきてやったんだよ！\n物質界中から！ ありったけの力ってやつをよ！\n俺達:
We brought these!
From all across the Material World! All the power we could muster!
Take this! The fruits of our adventures!
m920186.指揮官が死に急いでどうするのですか。\nデシウス様、物質界侵略は未だ第一段階。\: What are you hurrying the commander to death for? Lord Decius, the material-world invasion is only in its first stage. Reporting to the Demon King should take priority.
m920186.捨て駒ってわけですのね……。\nそういうやり口、気に入りませんわ……！！:
So you're just a pawn, then…
I really dislike that kind of trickery…!!
m920186.文字通り、以前ケラウノスの依り代だった頃のように、\n私の身体にアイギス様、\n:
Literally, just as I was the vessel for Keranos before,
I would allow Aigis and Adamas
to reside within my body.
m920186.本当に困った人ですよねぇ。\n後で色んな人に叱られても知りませんからねー！:
You really are a troublemaker.
I don't care if you get scolded by everyone later!
m920186.東の国、北の大国デハ、他の幹部が\n随分と苦戦させられたようダガ、\n北の大国か: In the eastern lands, the great northern nation—other commanders have struggled badly, but from that north to here, the distance is—
m920186.東の国も！ 『破滅の力』も！\n絶対に渡さないんだから！: The Eastern Kingdom! The “Power of Ruin”! We'll never hand them over!
m920186.果ての見えない暗闇に、\n支えもなく浮いている構造物……。\nもしかして、ここが:
An endless darkness,
with structures floating in midair without any support....
Could this be the Demon Lord's Castle...?
m920186.残念だったな。\nこの世界は、もはや予の物だ。:
How regrettable.
This world is mine now.
m920186.気合は十分なようだな。\nこのまま魔王城に突っ込むからな。\n振り落とされるんじ: Looks like you're fired up enough. We'll charge straight into the Demon Lord's castle. Don't get knocked down!
m920186.油断するからですよ、まったく。\nですが、私達の役目は完遂できました。:
You get careless, and that's your problem.
But, we have fulfilled our duty.
m920186.油断するとこ、全然学習してないね！\n喰らえぇぇぇっ！！:
You really don't learn from your mistakes, do you!
Eat this!!
m920186.火山地帯は絶え間なく噴火し、森は枯れ、\n大地には無数の亀裂が走り……。\n人が:
Volcanic regions are erupting nonstop, forests are withering,
and countless fissures are tearing through the earth…
It's only a matter of time before the land becomes uninhabitable…
m920186.無謀な戦いを、いつも塗り替えてきたのは誰なのか。\n幾度も刃を交えてきた、\nあ:
Who has always turned reckless battles into victories?
You, who have crossed blades with us so many times,
should know that well.
m920186.無駄ではありません。\n魔王よ、千年戦争を終わらせる時です。:
It is not futile.
Demon King, the time has come to end the Millennium War.
m920186.王子、この『熱波』の中じゃ、\n徐々に体力を削られちゃうわ。\n私達風水使いの力:
Prince, in this "heat wave,"
our stamina is being drained little by little.
Make good use of our wind and water magic!
m920186.王子、ガオレオンが前線に現れました！: Prince, Gaoleon has appeared on the front line!
m920186.王子、シビラ達をお願いね。\n東の国の『破滅の力』は、絶対に奪わせないから。: Prince, please take care of Shibira and the others. We won't let anyone steal the Eastern Kingdom's “Power of Ruin.”
m920186.王子、世界樹に向かいましょう。\nおそらく、事態は一刻を争うはずです！: Prince, let's head to the World Tree. Time is of the essence!
m920186.王子、先を急ぎましょう。\n白の帝国も、そろそろ合流するはずです。:
Prince, we should press on.

The White Empire should be catching up to us soon.
m920186.王子、勝ちましょう。\nこの世界の皆が、力を貸してくれています……！！:
Prince, let's win this.
Everyone in this world is lending us their strength……!!
m920186.王子、千年戦争の終結を。\n魔王ガリウスとの長き戦いの終わりを伝えてください。:
Prince, the end of the Millennium War.
Please tell us the war with Demon King Garius is over.
m920186.王子、千年戦争の終結を告げに行きましょう。\n本当に、本当にお疲れさまでした！:
Prince, let's go announce the end of the Millennium War.
You've truly done an amazing job!
m920186.王子、天守よりクラールフが現れました。\n『豪雨』を招く力にご注意を！: Prince, Kralhu has appeared from the keep. Watch out for his “Heavy Rain” power!
m920186.王子、戦いの結果がどうなったとしても、\n私達はあなたに、最後まで付いていきます:
Prince, no matter how this battle ends,
we will stand by you until the very end.
m920186.王子、東の国はあてたちで支えるよ。\n北の大国を助けに行ってあげて！: Prince, we'll hold the Eastern Kingdom with our forces. Go help the northern great nation!
m920186.王子、決戦は目前です。\nこれまでの戦いの結末が、ここにあります。\n必ず、魔王:
Prince, the decisive battle is at hand.
The outcome of all our struggles lies here.
We will surely take the world back from the Demon Lord's grasp!
m920186.王子、物質界を救ったその偉業を示す名です。\n英雄王としての力を振るう際には、\:
Prince, it is a name that honors the feat of saving the Material World.
When you wield the power of the Hero King,
please change your title to “The One Who Succeeds the Hero King.”
m920186.王子、異界召喚士が魔王の影を召喚しました！: Prince, the Otherworld Summoner has summoned the Demon King's shadow!
m920186.王子、白の皇帝を助けに行ってあげて。\n大事な戦友、なんでしょう？:
Prince, go help the White Emperor.
Your important comrade, right?
m920186.王子、連中が起き上がってきたなら、\n復活できなくなるまで叩きのめしてやれ。:
Prince, if they get back up,
beat them down until they can't revive.
m920186.王子、飛空船はいつでも離陸できるぜ。\nあんたがいないと飛び立てないからな、\n: Prince, the airship can launch anytime. It won't take off without you, so give the orders quickly!
m920186.王子、魔王ガリウスの障壁が破られました！\nここで、全ての戦いを終わらせましょう:
Prince, Garius's barrier has been broken!
Let's end all this fighting right now!
m920186.王子、魔王軍はふたりの幹部を送り込んできたわ。\nデシウスとクラールフの軍勢が、: Prince, the Demon King's army has sent two of their commanders. Decius and Kralhu's forces have invaded the Eastern Kingdom simultaneously.
m920186.王子、魔王軍幹部の連合軍が来ます！\nおそらくは総力戦となります。\nどうか、物: Prince, the Demon Lord's elite forces are arriving! It'll likely turn into an all-out war. Please, win for the Material World!
m920186.王子、魔界の門から魔物が出てきます！\n急ぎ戦闘の準備をお願いします！: Prince, monsters are pouring out of the demon-world gate! Hurry and get us ready for battle!
m920186.王子が、英雄王……？\nふふ、いい響きじゃないか。:
The Prince, the Hero King……?
Heh, that's a fine title, isn't it?
m920186.王子が諦めないのなら、\n私達が諦めるわけにはいきませんよね。:
If the Prince refuses to give up,
then we can't afford to either.
m920186.王子さま、どうしてここにいるんですかー！？: Your Highness, why are you here!?
m920186.王子さまは戦後の処理で引っ張りだこですし、\nここは王子さまに頼らずに――って、:
His Highness is swamped with post-war affairs,
so we should handle this without relying on him――wait, what?
m920186.王子よ、かつてお前は予に、\nこの世界が予の物ではないと言ったな。:
Prince. Once, you told me
that this world was not mine to claim.
m920186.王子よ、嗚呼、我が終生の好敵手よッ！！\n聖槍を担い、魔王を名乗る神を討て！\n:
Prince! Ah, my great rival of a lifetime!!

Take up the Holy Lance and slay the god who calls himself Demon King!

Prove that I lived! Let you carve my name into history!!
m920186.王子よ、諦めることなく、剣を掲げ続けた者よ。\n三女神全ての力を、あなたに委ねま:
Prince, you who never gave up and kept raising your sword.
We entrust you with the power of all Three Goddesses.
m920186.王子君……でも、もう何も打つ手は……！: Prince… but we have no more moves left…!
m920186.王子殿下ぁぁぁぁっ！！\n伝令！ 伝令です！ 緊急事態です！！:
Your Highness!!!
A messenger! It's a messenger! It's an emergency!!
m920186.王子軍には、我輩が迷惑をかけた者もいたな。\n今はただ、済まなく思っている。:
There were those among us who caused the Prince's army trouble.
I can only feel regret for what I did.
m920186.異界召喚士、同じ魔の道を歩む者として、\nあなたを許すわけにはいきません。:
Otherworld Summoner, as one who walks the same path of darkness,
I cannot forgive you.
m920186.痛ぁ……くないも～ん♪\nだい、ふっ、かぁ～つ♪:
Ow… no, wait, I'm fine~♪
I'm doing just fine~♪
m920186.瘴気の発生源は『破滅の力』そのものか。\nまるで俺がさまよってた、魔界の深淵みた:
The source of the miasma is the "Power of Ruin" itself.
It's just like the depths of the Demon Realm I once wandered through.
m920186.発生源さえ停止できれば、大地の自浄作用で、\n徐々に地上は元に戻っていくはずです:
If we can halt the source, the earth's self-purification should
gradually restore the surface to normal.
m920186.皆、王子の言葉を待っているのよ。\n新たな英雄王の言葉を、\n未来がここから始ま:
Everyone is waiting for the Prince's words.
The words of the new Hero King,
the words that will announce the beginning of a new future.
m920186.目に見える被害だけではない。\nおそらくは『破滅の力』を発生源に、\n瘴気の濃度:
It's not just the visible damage.
Likely originating from the "Power of Ruin,"
the concentration of miasma is rising rapidly.
m920186.知ったことかぁぁぁぁっ！！\nさぁ魔王様、あなた様の手足となって動く、\n無数の:
I don't careee!!
Now then, Demon King. I have unleashed countless reflections
to serve as your hands and feet across the world!!
m920186.短き間ではあったが、かけがえなき友よ。\n――どうか、お前にとって悔いなき戦いを:
Though our time together was short, you are an irreplaceable friend.
――Please, fight a battle you can be proud of.
m920186.確かに、本来の天使は\n神の命を受けて戦う兵器ですからね。:
That's right. In their true nature, angels

are weapons that fight only by the will of the gods.
m920186.確かにサナラの、地脈を導く力は強力ですが、\n神殺しにはまだ届かないでしょう。\:
Sanara's power to guide the ley lines is certainly formidable,
but it still falls short of god-slaying.
If we could borrow the power of an equal god…… perhaps……
m920186.神様が奇跡を起こすために使う力……？\nそんな大変なもののひとつが、\n世界樹に:
A power the gods use to work miracles...?
You're saying that one of those powerful things
has been embedded in the World Tree?
m920186.神殿の古文書に、神々を宿した上で生存したという、\n特殊な体質を持つ人物の記録が:
The temple's ancient texts contain records of individuals with a special constitution who survived after housing the gods.
I suspect she is a descendant of that lineage.
m920186.神無き世界を、人の力で、\n神々を打ち破り進むのです、人の子よ。:
In a world without gods, by the strength of man,
shatter the gods and forge ahead, child of man.
m920186.私ニ命令するナ……。\nソシテ魔王様の理想のタメ、お前も戦うのダ。: Obey my command… And for the Demon King's ideal, you will fight as well.
m920186.私達は力を使い果たしてしまいましたから、\nもう、こうして力を貸すことは難しくな:
We have exhausted our power.
It will be difficult for us to lend you our strength again.
m920186.突如、前触れもなく天使が侵攻してきたんです。\n世界樹の周囲は常に、\nグリフィ:
The angels launched a sudden invasion without any warning.
The area around the World Tree should always be
on high alert with the Griffin cavalry, yet...
m920186.笑止ッ！ 諦めぬというのなら、\nチャンピオンたる我が自ら引導を渡すのみよッ！！:
Ridiculous! If you refuse to give up,
then I, the Champion, shall guide you to the grave myself!!
m920186.経験則だけでなく、\n記録の上でも彼女の言うことは正しいです。:
Not only is it based on experience,
but the records confirm that what she says is true.
m920186.絶対に乗り越えられない壁を、\n常に打ち破り、答えを導き出してきたのが、\n果た:
Who has always shattered walls deemed impossible to cross,
and found the answer?
m920186.絶対に勝ちましょう。\nもう誰も、泣かなくて済むように。: We'll absolutely win. So that no one has to cry any more.
m920186.致し方ない……。\n覚悟せよ、王子共め……！！: It can't be helped… Prepare yourselves, princes…!!
m920186.良いだろう。\nようやくこの世界に興味がわいた。\n予が自ら、お前達の相手をして:
Very well.
This world has finally earned my interest.
I shall take you on myself……!!
m920186.茨の女王のつるは、\n絡め取った者の動きを鈍くします。\n王国の者達よ、決して油:
The vines of the Queen of Thorns
slow down the movements of those they entangle.
People of the kingdom, please do not let your guard down…….
m920186.行くぞ、騎士達よ。\nこの世界最後の闘争は、我輩達のものだ！！: Forward, knights! This final struggle of the world belongs to us!!
m920186.覚悟はデキテいるようダナ。\n魔王様の手を煩わセるまでもナイ。\nここデ、物質界:
You seem ready.
There is no need to trouble the Demon Lord.
We will cut down the last forces of the Material World right here.
m920186.言葉を重ねるつもりはありません。\nただ、あの御方より言伝を預かっております。:
I have no intention of exchanging pleasantries.
I merely carry a message from that person.
m920186.誇張でも何でもなく、\n本当に物質界全てを救ったのですから、\n英雄王の名を継い:
It's no exaggeration.
He truly saved the entire Material World,
so I think he deserves to inherit the name of Hero King.
